subject: My friend Sharice

body:
| I am so proud to stand alongside my friend, Sharice Davids, in Congress and fight together to improve our communities.

Recent polls show that Americans’ trust in our political system is at a new low. I understand why people are so frustrated. This year, we’ve seen the extreme House GOP threaten benefits like Social Security and Medicare, bring our government to the brink of shutdown and waste valuable time infighting all to elect an anti-LGBTQ+, anti-choice, election denying Mike Johnson as House Speaker.

The cost of living is high, women’s health freedoms are under attack in states across the country, and we’re heading towards climate catastrophe. And too many of our leaders refuse to step up.

But, Sharice isn’t backing down and neither am I. She is focused on critical issues like working on the new Farm Bill, fighting for abortion rights and fighting back against extremist politicians who want to attack our freedoms.

**_[There’s a lot at stake as we approach Election Day. That’s why we need your help to show our strength in our final FEC report of 2023. Can you help us and chip in $20 TODAY, split between Sharice Davids and me so we raise the $13,000 we need before the new year?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76061668/446537696/1743933305?amount=20&source=EM_NBI_SD_20231229_FR_3.7_0_6MO_cleaversurrogate_NA_NA_EOY&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NTc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YzFhY2VjNC1hN2E2LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjFmNTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=owKi7pwlg8tWhgTakKZ2W-PWSiBnw05wi24NGFSloBc=)_**

Sharice and I are in Congress fighting for you, not for the sake of grandstanding or getting media attention. We are willing to work with whoever is willing to come to the table if it means results for our constituents.

But, Republicans are already putting a huge chunk of their resources into spreading disinformation about her record and it’s only going to escalate before Election Day.

Their mission has been publicly shared. It’s to take over districts like KS-03 to expand their House majority. We can’t let that happen.

Come Election Day we want to make sure we did everything possible to win our races and keep fighting for our community. **_[Will you chip in $20 to help Sharice and me ensure a victory against extremism?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76061669/446537698/1743933305?amount=20&source=EM_NBI_SD_20231229_FR_3.7_0_6MO_cleaversurrogate_NA_NA_EOY&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NTc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YzFhY2VjNC1hN2E2LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjFmNTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=owKi7pwlg8tWhgTakKZ2W-PWSiBnw05wi24NGFSloBc=)_**

Happy Friday, I just got out of a meeting with my campaign team and wanted to share a few takeaways with you.
**Where we stand:** This Sunday is our last end-of-quarter deadline of the year. Right now we’re still very short of our 2,000-donor goal. If you can afford to chip in right now, [here is the link](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76061715/446538860/-175591075?&refcode=E5576-20231228-MajorDecision-SL-DeadlineEOQ&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDMxMTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiODk3ODczMTctYThhNi1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIxZjU0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=4k64X9bZVQ3ziOG7_M8nsP6WZhOGuI4raloj8pQGGkY=).
**Why this goal matters:** This end-of-year deadline is a big deal because we’re about to submit our next fundraising report to the FEC. If our fundraising numbers are low, it sends a flashing light to national Republicans and our GOP opponent that we’re in trouble. It also directly impacts some big budget decisions we have to make ahead of our March 5th election.
**What decisions we need to make:** One of our strategic advantages last cycle was how early we invested in grassroots organizing, especially latino outreach. It meant we spoke to voters early and often (and in-language). It's a big decision to spend money on organizing this early and I can't approve the money if we miss our fundraising goal.
**Other considerations:** Outside money is always a huge threat in this toss-up seat. We have to match the Republicans dollar for dollar in fundraising in order to combat their onslaught of ads. We’re expecting a barrage of attacks before the upcoming March election. If they spend $500,000 on attack ads against me, we have to spend $500,000 back. It’s that simple.
**What I need from this team:** Well, I need your help hitting our final end-of-quarter fundraising goal! If we hit the goal, I can approve the funding. I really believe in early organizing, but I can't do it if the money's not there.
That’s why I’m asking you to please send in the biggest donation you possibly can right now.
Here is a link: [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/JHCA-09-Email-Dec2023-FR-EOQ?refcode2=Peter](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76061716/446538861/-175591075?&refcode=E5576-20231228-MajorDecision-SL-DeadlineEOQ&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDMxMTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiODk3ODczMTctYThhNi1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIxZjU0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=4k64X9bZVQ3ziOG7_M8nsP6WZhOGuI4raloj8pQGGkY=)
Thank you for everything you are doing to protect our democracy. It means the world knowing I have supporters like you who always have my back during critical moments like this!
\- Josh

Josh Harder for Congress
PO Box 4220
Manteca, CA 95337
United States

As you read this email, political pundits are calling IL-17 “the only competitive House race in Illinois,” and Republicans have released yet another list with Eric singled out as a top target. Last cycle, Republicans were able to take the House by a razor-thin margin. They poured millions into IL-17 to defeat Eric, but he fended them off thanks to a strong base of local, grassroots support. One thing about Eric: Even after a tough year in Washington, he's still that hometown meteorologist who keeps the focus on his neighbors every single day. That is what won over the people of Northwest and Central Illinois, and it’s what makes him who we need in the district going forward. We are in the homestretch of Eric’s FINAL FEC deadline of his first year as an elected member of Congress. YOUR support — right now — is critical to his team’s strategy of keeping the GOP at bay and IL-17 blue. Thank you so much for your support, Peter. Tammy Duckworth | | Paid For By Eric Sorensen for Illinois Eric Sorensen is a meteorologist born and raised in Rockford, IL representing IL-17 in Congress. He’s seen firsthand the importance of establishing trust with the community, and he’s determined to use his expertise as a climate communicator to fight for Illinoisans on environmental justice and more in Washington. Hi there, Jimmy Kimmel here. I know you’re used to seeing me on your TV screen, but today I’m reaching out to you about an important topic close to my heart: ending America’s gun violence crisis.
Gun violence isn’t always in the headlines, and it can be far too easy for us to go about our daily lives and forget that it’s happening each and every day. But for the families who now have empty seats at their dinner table—like the families who lost a child in Newtown, Parkland, or Uvalde—they can never, ever forget.
[**GIFFORDS is doing lifesaving work at the forefront of the gun safety movement, and I'm proud to be an ambassador for this incredible organization. Will you join me today in supporting GIFFORDS PAC by making a contribution to support their crucial work?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-dec23.vYScJV&refcode=em231229-2-30-nor&t=2&akid=7117%2E3935704%2EOsU1fb)
**[DONATE](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-dec23.vYScJV&refcode=em231229-2-30-nor&t=3&akid=7117%2E3935704%2EOsU1fb)**
Gun violence is a uniquely American epidemic. This year alone, we’ve experienced record numbers of mass shootings. The leading cause of death for children in our nation is gun violence.
This is the only developed country in the world where this happens. We have to do something to change this.
Laws such as universal background checks, safe storage laws, and extreme risk protection orders would help ensure that guns can’t fall into the hands of people who shouldn’t have access to them. We call these laws commonsense because that’s just what they are—common sense.
It is long past time for our representatives to do their job and truly represent the American people. The majority of Americans support commonsense gun safety legislation. Yet far too many of our politicians make the choice to stall the passage of lifesaving legislation because they’re afraid to stand up to the gun lobby.
[**This is not a moment where we can sit back. We must be loud and use our collective voice to make a change. So please, will you make a commitment to ending our nation’s gun violence crisis by donating $3 to my friends at GIFFORDS PAC today? They have a critical FEC fundraising deadline coming up, so your support at this moment is crucial:**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-dec23.vYScJV&refcode=em231229-2-30-nor&t=4&akid=7117%2E3935704%2EOsU1fb)

clean_body: We must be loud and use our collective voice to make a change. Hi there, Jimmy Kimmel here. I know you’re used to seeing me on your TV screen, but today I’m reaching out to you about an important topic close to my heart: ending America’s gun violence crisis. Gun violence isn’t always in the headlines, and it can be far too easy for us to go about our daily lives and forget that it’s happening each and every day. But for the families who now have empty seats at their dinner table—like the families who lost a child in Newtown, Parkland, or Uvalde—they can never, ever forget. Gun violence is a uniquely American epidemic. This year alone, we’ve experienced record numbers of mass shootings. The leading cause of death for children in our nation is gun violence. This is the only developed country in the world where this happens. We have to do something to change this. Laws such as universal background checks, safe storage laws, and extreme risk protection orders would help ensure that guns can’t fall into the hands of people who shouldn’t have access to them. We call these laws commonsense because that’s just what they are—common sense. It is long past time for our representatives to do their job and truly represent the American people. The majority of Americans support commonsense gun safety legislation. Yet far too many of our politicians make the choice to stall the passage of lifesaving legislation because they’re afraid to stand up to the gun lobby. | Whether you’re a farmworker in Half Moon Bay or a health care worker in Los Angeles — Adam is fighting for you.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=4788%2E5257348%2EHFwcy4)
Earlier this month at an event with his wealthy donors, Donald Trump said, **_“You’re all people that have a lot of money. You’re rich as hell. We’re gonna give you tax cuts.”_**
That’s the type of Republican Party we’re up against, Derek: Tax cuts for the rich and the mega-corporations while working people struggle to earn enough to make ends meet.
**[Adam is running for Senate to foster an economy that works for _all_ of _us_ — chip in to help power his fight. ](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=dec2023_abs_em.181qVM&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20231229_PM2_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=4788%2E5257348%2EHFwcy4)**
[DONATE](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=dec2023_abs_em.181qVM&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20231229_PM2_V1_S1&email=&t=5&akid=4788%2E5257348%2EHFwcy4)
---
Adam knows that to fix our economy, we need to ensure that the wealthy pay their fair share.
Let’s face it – corporations or billionaires should never ever pay less taxes than a construction worker or a teacher. And in our present tax system, that happens. A lot. It’s abhorrent.
**It’s long since been time to level the playing field.**
While Republicans continue to protect a tax system that rewards the wealthiest Americans and punishes working families, Democrats like Adam are passing legislation to make the economy work for everyone and help people get back on their feet.
Addressing housing unaffordability. Improving living conditions. Supporting mental health care and fair pay. Standing side by side with workers on the picket lines as they strike for better wages.
**Whether you’re a farmworker in Half Moon Bay or a healthcare worker in Los Angeles — Adam is fighting for you.**

Today resolutions are typically about health and personal improvement. Let me propose, however, that we resolve to stand strong against the ill winds blowing across our land. Let us resolve [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=66358&L=28791&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9qLXJlY29yZHMtb24tcmFpZC1vbi1qYW1lcy1va2VlZmVzLWhvbWUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=c4e04925cbaa2cf69016ef6c7b4b0ecfe2d4dfd1e2e71ede181b8f841572d784] to stand with those being censored by the federal government. Let us resolve [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=66358&L=26903&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvaWxsZWdhbC1pbW1pZ3JhbnQtbXVyZGVycy1mb3VyLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=a08a81b42bde3fae164d7ed14df6faaa6527bd593ce814da26296d3a2915a01f] to stand with those whose lives are shattered by leftist policies on crime. He wanted to “cast some forward light upon the dark, inscrutable mysteries of the future.” He toasted them: > Here’s to 1942, here’s to a year of toil—a year of struggle > and peril, and a long step forward towards victory. May we all come > through safe and with honour. **Now, we’ve got to keep this momentum going.** Our last major FEC fundraising deadline of 2023 is just days away, and after that, everyone — including Josh Hawley and all the insiders propping up his campaign — will be able to see exactly how much support is behind our grassroots movement to elect Lucas Kunce.

Don’t sit this one out... | = Peter, I’ve got a huge announcement that should bring a smile to your face and hope to your heart: former federal prosecutor, Will Rollins announced his campaign for Congress in California’s 41st district -- one of the most important races in the country in the effort by Democrats to retake the House. Will stunned political experts in 2022 when he came so close to winning against right wing Republican, Ken Calvert. It ended up being one of the closest races in the country. He outperformed every projection and was the only Democratic challenger in California to win the independent vote. That’s a big deal. There is no question in my mind that in this upcoming election, with the Presidency on the ballot, the larger turnout will be the key to victory IF we have a strong campaign. I have committed my energy, time and money to this race and today I am asking you to start Will off with a show of support that will send him a message that we are behind him 100 percent. = | = Here’s why Democrats across the country should pay close attention to this race: 1. We need candidates like Will in Congress. As a former federal prosecutor, he understands the ongoing danger that extremism poses to our democracy. He brought justice to insurrectionists, and I know he'll take the oath to defend democracy as seriously now as he did in the Justice Department. 2. Retaking the House runs through CA-41. After the new lines were drawn, CA-41 became a true swing seat. It’s the type of district Democrats MUST WIN to regain Congress. 3. GOP super PACs. Despite the tough midterm environment in 2022, Will was the third most “overperforming” Dem challenger in the country. He was also heavily outspent by the GOP’s dark money machine. If Democrats help Will keep pace, he can flip this seat! 4. Will’s opponent Ken Calvert has got to go. Calvert voted to overturn the 2020 presidential election. He backs the extreme ban on abortion -- including for instances of rape, and wants doctors who perform them to go to jail. CA-41 is home to one of the most LGBTQ-friendly cities in Palm Springs, yet Calvert staunchly opposes gay marriage. The rematch is on, folks. [| Dr. Lauren Schwartz Part 2 | The Role of Psychiatry in TransgenderismThe Kathy Barnette Show59:19
---|---](https://substack.com/redirect/c1f0250a-540f-4671-bc39-b126559c783f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
"Would you rather have a dead child or a trans child?" That's emotional manipulation. I think it should be criminal. Because what you're saying is these are your only two choices, and that's absolutely not accurate.
\- Dr. Lauren Schwartz
Dear Friends,
Protecting our children is something that I know most of us deeply care about. That being said, we often talk about the dangers of affirming one's "gender identity" without medical professionals. This week, I am releasing the *second part* of a 2-part conversation with Dr. Lauren Schwartz, a Board-Certified Psychiatrist by the American Board of Psychiatry and Neurology. In addition to completing residency, Dr. Schwartz has also completed a course in psychoanalytic theory through the Oklahoma Society for Psychoanalytic Studies to continue education in one of her areas of interest, psychodynamic and psychoanalytic psychotherapy. During this set of discussions, we talked about gender-affirming activism in the medical profession. This discussion is *absolutely crucial* for those who wish to understand better the threat that our children are facing.
From Part I:
[](https://substack.com/redirect/5b292637-c918-42f5-aef4-2a89016ec785?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
We covered the process of diagnosing and treating gender dysphoria in children, the risks of medicine-based care, the impact of activism in psychiatry, and Dr. Schwartz helped offer a critical look at the new transgenderism textbook for psychiatrists. This helps us further understand why we are witnessing a proliferation of gender-affirming "CARE".

name: American Defense News
subject: Big Pharma and the federal government
body:
In America, various industries have close ties to government regulators.

This sponsored message from American Defense News is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | | [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zm7rggb0iiiv0t4oj5d35gce5a6n9hmmc552bd6g_rp22sh2s8i6eo36cjj62o35c3h2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend,

In America, various industries have close ties to government regulators.

The pharmaceutical industry is one of the most notable and most troubling.

Last year alone, "Big Pharma" spent over $373 million on lobbying--much more than any other industry.

While the Constitution certainly protects the rights to free speech and to petition the government, it was never intended to grant the special privileges that are characteristic of today's bureaucratic, administrative state.

In addition, Big Pharma's reputation has come under attack in the wake of America's opioid epidemic--since 1999, more than 600,000 people have died from opioid overdoses in the U.S. and Canada alone--and the COVID pandemic.

Given these current controversies, we decided to host a conference to consider the rise of Big Pharma, its role in the declining state of American health, and ideas for reform.

**The result is a free online video series that reveals the truth about Big Pharma.**

When you watch this free video series, you'll learn about the collaboration between the federal government and pharmaceutical companies, the content of the "Pfizer documents," and the origins of Big Pharma and the opioid epidemic.

You'll also gain valuable insights into Anthony Fauci and the public health establishment from Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.

**You can receive instant access to this free video series right now using this secure link:**

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/big-pharma-cca/](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zvn9k7dv75v99bepabcjo0pr7aokdiu6d2vravm8_rp22sh2s8i6eo36cjj62o35c3h2bs)**

We filmed the series at a recent Center for Constructive Alternatives conference on the Hillsdale campus. You will not have to watch for long to discover why it was one of our most popular and well-attended events.

**Please use the secure link above to receive your Big Pharma video series. When you complete the form, we will email you the series so you can watch it immediately.**

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844**

body:
Below is an email I’m circulating to outstanding leaders and principled conservatives like you.

| | | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zbqndppog8mlliviju2vfvpmqt2d34ekdeds5378_rp22sh2s8i6eo36cjj62o31cjh2bs)
Hi Fellow American,

Below is an email I'm circulating to outstanding leaders and principled conservatives like you. I think you may be interested in seeing it.

Please review the message at your earliest convenience and let me know if you would like to participate.

Best wishes,

Riley Gaines

P.S. The deadline is approaching to raise $1.5 million to host my upcoming college campus tour. If you'd like to give online, here's a secure link for you:
**[https://secured.leadershipinstitute.org/rgc-082424/](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z7tl3fv8kuk8k65ufk9or22no2bbt4o53cdlu0p0_rp22sh2s8i6eo36cjj62o31cjh2bs)**

* * *

From: Riley Gaines <rileygaines@email.leadershipinstitute.org>
Send Date: August 9, 2023 9:55 AM
Subject: Did you see my announcement?

Dear Friend,

I hope you saw my announcement on Sean Hannity's show that I've partnered with the Leadership Institute to launch the Riley Gaines Center.

I'm the 12-time All-American swimmer who speaks out against transgender ideology and fights to defend basic truths - that men are men and women are women.

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types - patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left's cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America's freedoms.

When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you - that's when you know you're saying the right things.

For those who are attacked, vilified, and persecuted for their support of America's founding principles and traditional American values, the Riley Gaines Center sends a message that they are not alone - because I will stand bravely with them.

To train as many young people as I can to stand up for conservative principles, I must have the help of strong Leadership Institute supporters like you.

**[Will you help turn young men and women into Leaders for America?](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zsodnvpvfb7c19engbdick6sf6rfkcf8odrnqg2o_rp22sh2s8i6eo36cjj62o31cjh2bs)**

The Riley Gaines Center is the exclusive home of my work to lead this crucial cause through:

* Speaking events and media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women's identity and uphold vital truths.

* A coalition of women, student athletes, parents, and those who have been harmed by radical transgender ideology, to join me in speaking out across the country.

* A fast-growing team of speakers and grassroots organizers, who will help turn those ready to defend freedom into champions who put their principles into action.

---
Through the Riley Gaines Center, my fellow Leadership Institute colleagues and I will identify, recruit, train, mentor, and empower students, athletes, and parents across the country to become campus, community, and national Leaders for America.

Not only will these young leaders help our country right now. They will stand up for our principles for decades to come.

**[By joining me and the Leadership Institute team with your contribution to this new effort, you make a powerful difference for conservatives across the country, from college campuses to the halls of power.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zd7uo1i17m54gq4s6a9jct4sp4lnfkgcorfindjg_rp22sh2s8i6eo36cjj62o31cjh2bs)**

Thank you for your support and dedication to preserving commonsense truths and conservative principles in our country.

Stand bravely with me,

Riley Gaines
The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute

| This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zisgtlab4hi5i6966n29d5ts3c4behacrjliauho_rp22sh2s8i6eo36cjj62o35c9h2bs)

| | Dear friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life’s most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That’s why we produced “[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zts6n9f058qds5oh672i6tu83n9ulpgrl8hdtddo_rp22sh2s8i6eo36cjj62o35c9h2bs)” which you can now own on DVD.

name: ICYMI News
subject: The key to Lincoln’s rhetorical success
body:
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills

| This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zefp4f8cqk5h4s78h3ev4gf4cde6hs5ff44bicso_rp22sh2s8i6eo36cjj62o35c3h2bs)
---
| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly--plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.” **
Through** “Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.

Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...

name: David Horowitz
subject: Barack Obama’s revolution
body:
I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true.

| |
---
| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That’s why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** – and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I’m asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2znlvf4omo28p34c39odnupn2h480sc28ohpb20gg_rp22sh2s8i6eo36cjj62o31cjh2bs)** When you think of “the enemy within” you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn’t be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making – but most of the American people have no clue what we’re up against. **That’s why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state – and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as “white supremacists” and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... “A Great Book” – Dinesh D’Souza “ _The Enemy Within_ is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life.” – Mark Levin “David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation.” Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I was the enemy within — and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. We’ve reached the point in our history that will decide our future – and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[That’s why I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within when you donate $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left’s evil agenda to every American patriot.](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zgo69k2spg3vkd954lorpce6s3ckcmqdtok15rh0_rp22sh2s8i6eo36cjj62o31cjh2bs)** The Left is at war with America. They don’t simply disagree with us about how to make our country better – they want to destroy it to make way for their Marxist dystopia. Or in Obama’s own words “radically transform” America. **And they don’t care how much they have to lie, cheat or steal to achieve it.** So it’s up to patriots like you and me to expose the truth about the Left to our fellow Americans while we still can.
---
| | Sincerely,
---
---
David Horowitz
---
P.S. I know how we got to this point in our country, and I know how we get out. But the clock is ticking and our country is hanging by a thread. **[Please make a generous donation of $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and as a thank you, I’ll rush a complimentary copy of my book The Enemy Within to you.](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zanb3lcledrese2rk4iqca8orc23sumtefi1828o_rp22sh2s8i6eo36cjj62o31cjh2bs)**

name: American Briefing
subject: Big Pharma and the federal government
body:
In America, various industries have close ties to government regulators.

This sponsored message from American Briefing is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2znu1h53os81jfjs8mpl9voo5jbgl7k6uumce30o8_rp22sh2s8i6eo36cjj62o35c9h2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend,

In America, various industries have close ties to government regulators.

The pharmaceutical industry is one of the most notable and most troubling.

Last year alone, "Big Pharma" spent over $373 million on lobbying--much more than any other industry.

While the Constitution certainly protects the rights to free speech and to petition the government, it was never intended to grant the special privileges that are characteristic of today's bureaucratic, administrative state.

In addition, Big Pharma's reputation has come under attack in the wake of America's opioid epidemic--since 1999, more than 600,000 people have died from opioid overdoses in the U.S. and Canada alone--and the COVID pandemic.

Given these current controversies, we decided to host a conference to consider the rise of Big Pharma, its role in the declining state of American health, and ideas for reform.

**The result is a free online video series that reveals the truth about Big Pharma.**

When you watch this free video series, you'll learn about the collaboration between the federal government and pharmaceutical companies, the content of the "Pfizer documents," and the origins of Big Pharma and the opioid epidemic.

You'll also gain valuable insights into Anthony Fauci and the public health establishment from Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.

**You can receive instant access to this free video series right now using this secure link:**

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/big-pharma-cca/](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z57e1q2h0jnc1s99ecbaoqu510vu8470j5uhsocg_rp22sh2s8i6eo36cjj62o35c9h2bs)**

We filmed the series at a recent Center for Constructive Alternatives conference on the Hillsdale campus. You will not have to watch for long to discover why it was one of our most popular and well-attended events.

**Please use the secure link above to receive your Big Pharma video series. When you complete the form, we will email you the series so you can watch it immediately.**

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College

I’m the 12-time All-American swimmer who speaks out against transgender ideology and fights to defend basic truths - that men are men and women are women.

When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you - that’s when you know you’re saying the right things.

To train as many young people as I can to stand up for conservative principles, I must have the help of strong Leadership Institute supporters like you.

* A coalition of women, student athletes, parents, and those who have been harmed by radical transgender ideology, to join me in speaking out across the country.

name: 1600 Daily
subject: Who controls whom?
body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

| | | This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zphv5787uav0qcfe2sfqoog9m3hl6n7q6oc261go_rp22sh2s8i6eo36cjj6eor1c9h2bs)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zq7mn5fjtdnfu7p4krt29eotufv7466lo5mtd900_rp22sh2s8i6eo36cjj6eor1c9h2bs)**
## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z2vggd8706t7nl78187jf71ootelt1gmf8msbnqg_rp22sh2s8i6eo36cjj6eor1c9h2bs) [NO](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zsjg3t59phgvi6dm2a91jh8ju3a0gstbve1np40o_rp22sh2s8i6eo36cjj6eor1c9h2bs) For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zkg0qpje2ghbakj4s469tl663ghtn1tptbjpjl1g_rp22sh2s8i6eo36cjj6eor1c9h2bs)**
** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

subject: Big Pharma and the federal government
body:
In America, various industries have close ties to government regulators.

This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zvs7jj8heg0n4iibbdd8ht20d513lk0gnag2i3e8_rp22sh2s8i6eo36cjj6eor6cth2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend,

In America, various industries have close ties to government regulators.

The pharmaceutical industry is one of the most notable and most troubling.

Last year alone, "Big Pharma" spent over $373 million on lobbying--much more than any other industry.

While the Constitution certainly protects the rights to free speech and to petition the government, it was never intended to grant the special privileges that are characteristic of today's bureaucratic, administrative state.

In addition, Big Pharma's reputation has come under attack in the wake of America's opioid epidemic--since 1999, more than 600,000 people have died from opioid overdoses in the U.S. and Canada alone--and the COVID pandemic.

Given these current controversies, we decided to host a conference to consider the rise of Big Pharma, its role in the declining state of American health, and ideas for reform.

**The result is a free online video series that reveals the truth about Big Pharma.**

When you watch this free video series, you'll learn about the collaboration between the federal government and pharmaceutical companies, the content of the "Pfizer documents," and the origins of Big Pharma and the opioid epidemic.

You'll also gain valuable insights into Anthony Fauci and the public health establishment from Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.

**You can receive instant access to this free video series right now using this secure link:**

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/big-pharma-cca/](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z870ep2ckunl15u00edfs6gqrh05pjdh5185tak8_rp22sh2s8i6eo36cjj6eor6cth2bs)**

We filmed the series at a recent Center for Constructive Alternatives conference on the Hillsdale campus. You will not have to watch for long to discover why it was one of our most popular and well-attended events.

Dear Fellow Patriot,

The next presidential administration could be a turning point for our country.

After years of inflation, open borders, reckless spending, and rampant crime, America desperately needs effective governance grounded in our founding principles.

Unfortunately, a conservative victory in the next election is not enough to save our country.

That’s because today, the deep state controls D.C.

**Regardless of who is in office, career bureaucrats in our federal agencies like the Justice Department, Environmental Protection Agency, and the State Department independently push their own leftist agendas.

**In order to implement common-sense, conservative policies, we must have a plan to rein in these agencies and replace these leftist bureaucrats with principled conservatives.

The Heritage Foundation has that plan--called Project 2025.

**Through Project 2025, The Heritage Foundation has united 80 conservative organizations and is leading the charge for the next presidential transition plan.**

Heritage’s policy scholars created a comprehensive policy book and a plan to implement it starting day one of the next administration.

These policies include securing our borders, ensuring election integrity, and reversing the growth of regulations, spending, and inflation.

Additionally, we’re identifying and training qualified patriots to staff the next administration and replace the leftist bureaucrats - ending their control of the deep state.

**The radical leftist mainstream media has published several panicked articles attacking Heritage and Project 2025.**

But as we like to say, if the leftist media is angry at you, you’re over the target.

As 2024 rapidly approaches, we’re kicking Project 2025 into high gear.

Will you help us make this much needed program a massive success? Will you support Project 2025 with a special gift today?

By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly--plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.” **

| Peter, As we gear up to bid farewell to this year and welcome 2024, I have to say – we’ve faced some real challenges. But you know what? We tackled them head-on with the kind of Common Sense that's all too rare these days. This year, we stood firm against a tide of overreach, from the encroachment on parental rights in our schools to the imposition of far-left agendas and impractical statewide "green" mandates. **We showed that with a healthy dose of Common Sense and a lot of determination, we can stand up to the radical left.** Your support through all of this? Phenomenal. You’ve proven that when common sense leads the way, there’s no limit to what we can achieve. Together, we’ve made a significant impact, and that’s something to be truly proud of.

---

---
**Looking ahead to 2024, I'm more energized than ever. We've got plenty to tackle, and I know we're up to the challenge.**

It’s about taking bold action, making an impact, and showing the power of rallying around common sense solutions. I can’t express enough how much I appreciate you being part of this journey. Your energy, your commitment, it’s the fuel for this movement. With a big year ahead of us, I’m excited to see what we’ll achieve together. **So here’s to 2024 – a year filled with victories, growth, and steadfast Common Sense. It’s going to be our year – _let's make every moment count._** Wishing you a Happy New Year, and let's gear up to make some real waves! All the best, Bill

I’ll explain more below, but will you split a donation between Blue Amp Action and Josh Riley’s campaign right now?](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta163a0a5-07d9-4a17-9e2d-71319c0a3294/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| Marc Molinaro, the MAGA Republican representing NY-19 in Congress, voted TWICE to make Jim Jordan the Speaker of the House. When that didn’t work, he found the one guy even crazier than Jordan to actually give the job to. Most of the people I represent wouldn’t know the Speaker of the House if he backed over them with a pickup truck.” Does he think we’re dumb? [I, for one, do give a sh*t who’s running our government... and I know you do, too. If you’re as pissed off as I am, I hope you’ll split a contribution between Josh Riley and Blue Amp Action today to fire both Marc Molinaro AND Mike Johnson.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tab998af0-15fd-4c6d-9435-e57c97cef024/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) [CHIP IN NOW >>>](https://default.salsalabs.org/T03820f45-7661-4eb7-922a-6f09baeafdd4/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) It’s clear Molinaro doesn’t think much of the people he represents. But you know who does care a hell of a lot about Upstate New Yorkers? My friend and former Senate counsel, Josh Riley. [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T7117de58-9bda-413a-898d-e088fe20e74f/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
(I swear I’m not actually this short... Josh is just REALLY tall.) Josh grew up in a working-class neighborhood in Endicott, NY. When the local factories closed, Josh saw his community struggle – but he worked to put himself through school and graduated from Harvard Law. In the Senate, Josh and I brought Republicans and Democrats together to actually get stuff done (yes, it really is possible)! The bills we worked on together expanded rights for survivors of domestic abuse and provided new funding for addiction treatment and mental health programs. It wasn’t easy, but Josh got them signed into law. Josh DID learn how to drive on a pickup truck, so maybe Molinaro was right about that. But he’s dead wrong if he thinks we’re too stupid to know or care that he’s voting to screw us over at every turn. [This is one of the most competitive races in the country, and Josh isn’t going to get to Congress without our help. Please join me by splitting a contribution between Josh and Blue Amp Action right now.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T08f11992-4da1-4286-8ab1-55d4d66482b9/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

name: Reclaiming American Freedom
subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
The survey will only take a few moments of your time

This sponsored message from Reclaiming American Freedom is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=4d5979d6ada346ea94b7412c1e5d6dd5&_e=naVtFJyYYedU5CC_M1TcpqMH0dZGQVWBzSw7-t5sOBnaolRGlk0oU_h3csnxZCJ9o4kHuV3m5uvkqsMaUNqYTbYnEuU5NCx8EN1x0Y7pQMKE4OKVnPlf9VgnUz73aN6zK7ONX0mLG-22-s6mlnHCEXOaqo4y8MLetiupWDLrc9nhW7Vtbyl67N_mdJefAfRcDwiHaDXfrRPkUuzFouzHqJL1ylaa_VB31nHfZBGJRqBg-lCKH7xDqtLk4P8QFI56i9AxvF4eQgop-QV7NYWU2CuciRaEpRgnZyiUrr5TojRs0dWplHNa9NPb-WBEZkVrQiqIJc2ZBFsnyTKaYGcRjr0g03-B-ZT5WFOcfHdGEY03q-WB0sf3XyNmXzL0HMqEa1A0HlNxjZGF0jaYT4-pSQ%3D%3D) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it... Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints **That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Dear Friend,

I hope you saw my announcement on Sean Hannity's show that I've partnered with the Leadership Institute to launch the Riley Gaines Center.

I'm the 12-time All-American swimmer who speaks out against transgender ideology and fights to defend basic truths - that men are men and women are women.

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types - patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left's cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America's freedoms.

* Speaking events and media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women's identity and uphold vital truths.

* A coalition of women, student athletes, parents, and those who have been harmed by radical transgender ideology, to join me in speaking out across the country.

* A fast-growing team of speakers and grassroots organizers, who will help turn those ready to defend freedom into champions who put their principles into action.

---
Through the Riley Gaines Center, my fellow Leadership Institute colleagues and I will identify, recruit, train, mentor, and empower students, athletes, and parents across the country to become campus, community, and national Leaders for America.

Not only will these young leaders help our country right now. They will stand up for our principles for decades to come.

**[By joining me and the Leadership Institute team with your contribution to this new effort, you make a powerful difference for conservatives across the country, from college campuses to the halls of power.](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=569b4034271d4a47b717539755f46b82&_e=QqlmTRyiodjhlZzMq1X685C6Z-ijCrNZ2XEmqPaOgckl67WRd8epEV-sOKQK7FFwXxe_zekTj5vg6oAs5Qf5hjohemY4T3kc9igS3j4xyoI4swJgHHrjCdjbEIrPoSNIWX_xVyMl9NI_WPughtQHbj-WwdBwtYEu_wwImNdjGOnX1tjQkQD4OuspCssvhY8HUOFLuRX3HDhrozsEzl4YR4dDe3L4vYldklIrmp5Cmh2Q20bJb870kU7KqXkgYpq92h0TH1G75Vtp6ozr2VImPV6jcmVl2oTChWXduBEZoM_mSrvy0hl5EMUc0yHZll1EivA8C0-ErOSf2U3U7Lhnm20I0ddsORPULascJhH-XJ4%3D)**

Riley Gaines

# Saturday, December 30th, 2023
---|---
**Welcome to the weekend! **On this day in 1916, the mysterious Grigori Rasputin was killed in Saint Petersburg. The "Mad Monk" was a controversial mystic who convinced the Russian Imperial family that he could heal their son. He was also an alleged philanderer who many thought had too much influence, and he was murdered by relatives of Czar Nicholas II. [Read five myths and truths about Rasputin here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7tuhDAQQNGvsTtW9owfuHCRhm7TpkQDDMtE5iFwNtq_j5I69ZWudD7u_Z2kyPZ4p5VznfeexipP7i00aBrA3ukpz8zAqDnbaDA571zSS6YUA6VEwbbG84BAPNCAjJj8DO2oJYMBtIDGGh8QbxhmtOgHx5EmGlvlDE9S9_P2uctWF57La3_yeRv3VZe81HpcCt8UdAq6Kiv_BgWdCybE6BV0vllfdbmak67jq8qmoNNnno5vKUWuEJUzj5Wk_B3r_8CfAAAA__8gdE_w). ## Mexican Border Crossings Break Record
U.S. Border Patrol agents have [encountered over 276,000](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz71uxCAQBOCngc4W7OK_giKNu0ub0sKw2ETYnIA7694-ujRp0n4z0mi-bsvNhBjO7dMcpKtPi7E1PGmR0KBoABfFnfZEQMhJy0HgpDqlJr7rgQB742F0Uw9uhE5IoTrlV8DRTsLyoEEASkAhRdcjtth7lNitigbjjB2ZEuRCTbn9TuGsO_n4Sk_KrU0Hj3qv9V4YfjCYGczXdbV2LSdd5Z0zmO0erNkSg_mNf9Ac5pVyc4Qtm7OWpjzWR17fBZ61u18hxlD6gSmxHSbE37X6__mfAAAA___SE1tp) illegal immigrants at the Mexican border in December--a new monthly record. An additional 50,000 migrants entered legally at ports of entry. Amidst the surge at the border, US Secretary of State Anthony Blinken met with Mexico's president to discuss the problem. President Obrador says he's willing to help, but he [wants to see progress](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAQQL_G3ojOHCZmYOiSLV07WgecHSpsIiBO26-v0rnj01ue3sd1vlJMcV_faWPbljyTb_HgeZACQUicVR_swiwZe7bDGdCoUSnT3-wU0BFLCFo7WAgNMQPCqP3oQKmpj1aCxEEiDDBqxBPqBQccneIzBfJTp4BDbLmcPnPc242X9J0PLieftz7ZW2v32uFbJy-dvNB952d9qReUFn3iTl42_oo-C5dL4CJ8ybXGfa1ii2uhvVVx8M4_D04k_MOR0JNSbHQA45jlpI1WbBz5YQygF0d9seH-jCnFqs-dgnWjmP6C2v9_fgMAAP__ywlnEw) in US/Cuba relations in return.

Mayors in major U.S. cities like Denver, Chicago, and New York [are discussing](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz71uxCAQBOCngc4W7OK_giKNu0ub0sKw2ETYnIA7694-ujRp0n4z0mi-bsvNhBjO7dMcpKtPi7E1PGmR0KBoABfFnfZEQMhJy0HgpDqlJr7rgQB742F0Uw9uhE5IoTrlV8DRTsLyoEEASkAhRdcjtth7lNitigbjjB2ZEuRCTbn9TuGsO_n4Sk_KrU0Hj3qv9V4YfjCYGczXdbV2LSdd5Z0zmO0erNkSg_mNf9Ac5pVyc4Qtm7OWpjzWR17fBZ61u18hxlD6gSmxHSbE37X6__mfAAAA___SE1tp) how to deal with the unsustainable influx of migrants, and they're continuing to ask the Biden administration for help.
## High Waves Batter California, Hawaii
Stormy conditions in the Pacific are [generating waves](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7FuwyAQQL8Gb1hwh514YOjiLV07Wmc4YipiIkyM-vdVOnd70hue3tdtuVFMcb9_0oNtDXkhV-PJiwaJSgIupvM2MANjx1ZfFE5mMGbqNgtmCnrQFNgR6dU45bwKk7sa1KNfr120oAA1oNJqGBF7HANqHFbDF_LkrsIo9rHm0n_nuNeNQ_rJJ5fe5UeX7Fbr8xD4IWAWMLfWerceO7fj7QXMbxQwl3x_sWx0sjx5r69C0lGKIZc9klyZ3CZg7or1zxZTisd4EUbdHxTTX6j-__0bAAD___NvWsE) as high as 35 feet on the California coast. In Ventura, a huge wave sent bystanders scrambling after it rolled over a seawall, and eight people went to the hospital with injuries. The surge of water flowed down a nearby street for an entire block. ([See Video](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsjz1PwzAQQH-NvbWy7_yVwQMM2VpGxsixL42R01TJ0Yh_j4CV7UlPetJ7vwyXVFu9365pocjTOqTM9UmDhhOqE-BgZIkTERBKitor7Iw1ppNz7Egl410o2YbsyjiWMGLpRos6h-ysrBEUoAZUWlmHeEY3oUY7GvKppByEUVQqr9v5Y613nmlqX-uTtnNeF9nizPzYBb4I6AX0fFTmPyegf72-XenYBfQ7J_78Ae2Nsp3ygDYY50F5I7dYHkdtre7OC6NuS6rtt87_z34HAAD__wtLUuI))

The National Weather Service is warning of "_dangerous surf, life-threatening rip currents and coastal flooding_ " this weekend in California. In Hawaii, forecasters are predicting 40-foot waves on north-facing shores.
## Beer Sales Plummet
Beer sales in the U.S. are expected to plunge to their lowest level in 24 years, partly due to [Bud Light's 25% sales decline](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0D2PszAQBOBfY7qN7LX5SOHibejytlcig5dkT_5A2CHi35-4-rpHGmk0mq_H9HAcOD3_u0i2rnlyS-WDJoWgJaCeTOPtSoSkG7Kql_puWmPuzcsOnVfDamTf4rAYTX0vZ7XcB9_O84BuaNiiRK1QSyXbTuub7latdDsb6p13yyCMJM8177fvzKm-aA1nPmi_LTk2wb5q3YrQ_wSOAsd0brnUKxI4XsUCR4WXe4Hj_C6cqJSLRDsUF6jAFt4xUuX0hJoh5A-VCoEOCsAJ0MBJbi_gInvwZ3AJ4jscLtEJK7uyZIFjs1u_fTgELl0vjHxGx-F3Yf37sJ8AAAD__4vLbDg) but just as much by the changing habits of younger drinkers. Sales declined overall by 5% in the first nine months of the year, according to Beer Marketer's Insights. Bud Light sales alone dropped by up to 30% and dragged down Anheuser-Busch sales overall. But beer is also being crowded out by the [changing tastes of young drinkers](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL9uwyAQh58Gb1jA4dgeGLJ4S5cOlbpYBM4JLX8iIHH99hWdO93p7tN9p9_HZb1o5128vemAqm5p1aa6F65cUGBUwCo7qzZEgdCh4iODWQ5Szt1dcWZHg3a0m5bWTLMxA2MDMGTiOs0wdU4JJoALYJwNJ4AeThtwGK4SR221mYhkaF1Nuf9KLtY7bv5IL8y9SaHz6l7roxA4E7EQsez73ocS246IBSN9FiKWkCIerer8jbVNmpNeETMt2mOhrpEUfx5oKlpaE7VovIvYWp92LJXqkJ6xNrTpqWD0QJ3bNZ3p-czD_L58dlnZx-68d-U0EsluQTv_92r9P7nfAAAA__99HW_k), who have increasingly turned to hard seltzer and non-alcoholic drinks. And when Gen Z members do drink, surveys show they prefer spirits to beer.

* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. From: Riley Gaines <rileygaines@email.leadershipinstitute.org>
Send Date: August 9, 2023 9:55 AM
Subject: Did you see my announcement?

Dear Friend,

I hope you saw my announcement on Sean Hannity's show that I've partnered with the Leadership Institute to launch the Riley Gaines Center.

I'm the 12-time All-American swimmer who speaks out against transgender ideology and fights to defend basic truths - that men are men and women are women.

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types - patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left's cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America's freedoms.

When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you - that's when you know you're saying the right things.

For those who are attacked, vilified, and persecuted for their support of America's founding principles and traditional American values, the Riley Gaines Center sends a message that they are not alone - because I will stand bravely with them.

To train as many young people as I can to stand up for conservative principles, I must have the help of strong Leadership Institute supporters like you.

**[Will you help turn young men and women into Leaders for America?](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=5fabea9d06e248f4af24d70224783c2c&_e=qsuzCReO-5iT3VNyrudk8K3oW6aTTVHvK8qB9-s-AQBZcMS7XRONbIJDwWRr5rVMjjBKXprtBRPE98AVjIm8nxR7YIpWSQuhwAJf-Isw6rDjMVpAyCiq4W4zKJNp26WWRLdHDIYQhF6AaqTdUoRf9FwpaZFwFniQApTJzFW8qAoEXLNU2ICZVJB5NQGIk6B2OgpcVoGfY-8nNK2z4_CO9Tdq5P7Yjld3QnnpSlXY0X9CuiNUKkeh_V1JdNRQ-i8ICCWC3tW00uD1y4rQXoXRzQaoo9Amy78EYRokV1ceiH6MIn02R3toSvdM8qxQyhTrTd0rw3uRG3jAm6PUp6OEaCWte-FuFpjleGtclqFfXQ0%3D)**

The Riley Gaines Center is the exclusive home of my work to lead this crucial cause through:
* Speaking events and media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women's identity and uphold vital truths.

* A coalition of women, student athletes, parents, and those who have been harmed by radical transgender ideology, to join me in speaking out across the country.

* A fast-growing team of speakers and grassroots organizers, who will help turn those ready to defend freedom into champions who put their principles into action.

---
Through the Riley Gaines Center, my fellow Leadership Institute colleagues and I will identify, recruit, train, mentor, and empower students, athletes, and parents across the country to become campus, community, and national Leaders for America.

Not only will these young leaders help our country right now. They will stand up for our principles for decades to come.

**[By joining me and the Leadership Institute team with your contribution to this new effort, you make a powerful difference for conservatives across the country, from college campuses to the halls of power.](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=5fabea9d06e248f4af24d70224783c2c&_e=qsuzCReO-5iT3VNyrudk8K3oW6aTTVHvK8qB9-s-AQBZcMS7XRONbIJDwWRr5rVMjjBKXprtBRPE98AVjIm8nxR7YIpWSQuhwAJf-Isw6rDjMVpAyCiq4W4zKJNp26WWRLdHDIYQhF6AaqTdUoRf9FwpaZFwFniQApTJzFW8qAoEXLNU2ICZVJB5NQGIk6B2OgpcVoGfY-8nNK2z4_CO9S5iRE-uqnQ6571u0dSwFZpPhPt5G0rH3c2muU8yrA-G4GQTDFZHJ8UDIen4O4chDoww2RoOpZ0VfA1gv1qsi6spSeFAa4mvpXIrga0FCIQQ1tMmttf8WK9epQfVrmnI8g3ccaA1g2phfIcjhMyjrCw%3D)**

Thank you for your support and dedication to preserving commonsense truths and conservative principles in our country.

Stand bravely with me,

Riley Gaines
The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute

| | Dear friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life's most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

| | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That's why I hope you'll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful new DVD box set](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=590de7f8f45a4cedba89833aa55b1bf2&_e=yBx7-3SQTykeeHDETn9WXaMCzcvev5SrARBB3pHTwvk1Udg3PyQl2Hid0ZtOFcxMdgtlm2Ol0_UVsdCl4lHPy5a_IsseSqbYJWPX8kWJCEdL2iDDrtckqYNO4m_V3uWHEvhYKuApB7Iwgtd6YFb7ykeFIQb15wq2Lh0w4fIC-xxkfVkI4g57a67txMBxuHEtvRPvQc5Iw7To3aS5Ax4xuxIr3d157t2dIyMkamjFqF_6IyBf9JSX_wmeSuV8Z-xb9LRJ_EYEK3FziT_lNgHoq95HtxAnkqXoJNy_eWc0EOCs_DCHuUohz0Soa9XtQoIgJ2XA0fCBf6T8KlWj-9aBnfKpw4Vv-hH0KYqnrRroFz8L2JuwE__aE3uBdwzJROAMjkjt1BEdSJeifVnJYxGwL7s4mtrurdN84QP4ncwB_86WxPNDWx53gKG8cwQNRkKM).

subject: Big Pharma and the federal government.
body:
In America, various industries have close ties to government regulators.

This sponsored message from Reclaiming American Freedom is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | | [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=63e33b5357d446118a2361e0916aa1de&_e=oK5v_iBLaKphYbyXHlLszlsurgEgOpwo8S8qpkfX6KnKnQpNOarr1MnQ9OdxVOS67Q535R1OxL_ii7ZBleZ9lPrvRZMRaKKLCDc5xQGxyUjt8gqLZfxGY549cDReBKk68fgIFsQZXiI78kiK1otXfb6M0Oag-SQB-joIn_vjl9nQ9w3L2e131VsGUWQG2w1uD2BRmsZBdPd3IRpFHKkDQ4sKDstnbWUsNrH6rmaNl8sEq0uvdlvXD5skasHn-VOQidd-mocXjR2_i25VJVlu-nFSnft3tjVsb-oB-zSHt-c2jv3taeNxjorcUkAtWpoJf8vZZwQgiy_lMKVzKNWkWjpcsLoChFsAbD3gKLuIEM5aXAuxPIfDezYFLF40hyje)

| | Dear Friend,

In America, various industries have close ties to government regulators.

The pharmaceutical industry is one of the most notable and most troubling.

Last year alone, "Big Pharma" spent over $373 million on lobbying--much more than any other industry.

While the Constitution certainly protects the rights to free speech and to petition the government, it was never intended to grant the special privileges that are characteristic of today's bureaucratic, administrative state.

In addition, Big Pharma's reputation has come under attack in the wake of America's opioid epidemic--since 1999, more than 600,000 people have died from opioid overdoses in the U.S. and Canada alone--and the COVID pandemic.

Given these current controversies, we decided to host a conference to consider the rise of Big Pharma, its role in the declining state of American health, and ideas for reform.

**The result is a free online video series that reveals the truth about Big Pharma.**

When you watch this free video series, you'll learn about the collaboration between the federal government and pharmaceutical companies, the content of the "Pfizer documents," and the origins of Big Pharma and the opioid epidemic.

You'll also gain valuable insights into Anthony Fauci and the public health establishment from Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.

**You can receive instant access to this free video series right now using this secure link:**

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/big-pharma-cca/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=63e33b5357d446118a2361e0916aa1de&_e=oK5v_iBLaKphYbyXHlLszlsurgEgOpwo8S8qpkfX6KnKnQpNOarr1MnQ9OdxVOS67Q535R1OxL_ii7ZBleZ9lPrvRZMRaKKLCDc5xQGxyUjt8gqLZfxGY549cDReBKk68fgIFsQZXiI78kiK1otXfb6M0Oag-SQB-joIn_vjl9nQ9w3L2e131VsGUWQG2w1uD2BRmsZBdPd3IRpFHKkDQ4sKDstnbWUsNrH6rmaNl8vGmngn-g0PdyJ0Z9ctKeV3P5wXpdVNEQdpm9JMwoiyfswcXT6lOHjfEsjwRg8p8B_6tLdP9xYeOoHl5i0pzg7dsfiBdVhzQg0UsWh4iSRjyeWrveUf-2QL7ALKlhf3wz1c4r4FGXqP_khQcHHKR_he)**

We filmed the series at a recent Center for Constructive Alternatives conference on the Hillsdale campus. You will not have to watch for long to discover why it was one of our most popular and well-attended events.

**Please use the secure link above to receive your Big Pharma video series. When you complete the form, we will email you the series so you can watch it immediately.**

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College

Dear Friend,

I hope you saw my announcement on Sean Hannity's show that I've partnered with the Leadership Institute to launch the Riley Gaines Center.

I'm the 12-time All-American swimmer who speaks out against transgender ideology and fights to defend basic truths - that men are men and women are women.

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types - patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left's cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America's freedoms.

When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you - that's when you know you're saying the right things.

For those who are attacked, vilified, and persecuted for their support of America's founding principles and traditional American values, the Riley Gaines Center sends a message that they are not alone - because I will stand bravely with them.

To train as many young people as I can to stand up for conservative principles, I must have the help of strong Leadership Institute supporters like you.

**[Will you help turn young men and women into Leaders for America?](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/P6epIyIn4Y9hWX4_oQb9Eg~~/AARclAA~/RgRncrGSP0SUaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmVkLmxlYWRlcnNoaXBpbnN0aXR1dGUub3JnL3JnYy0wODI0MjQvP3V0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1yaWxleV9hcHBlYWwmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PVYyLVBBLVJPTi0yMDIzMTIzMFcDc3BjQgplg3IDkGXu1H22UhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)**

The Riley Gaines Center is the exclusive home of my work to lead this crucial cause through:

* Speaking events and media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women's identity and uphold vital truths.

* A coalition of women, student athletes, parents, and those who have been harmed by radical transgender ideology, to join me in speaking out across the country.

* A fast-growing team of speakers and grassroots organizers, who will help turn those ready to defend freedom into champions who put their principles into action.

---
Through the Riley Gaines Center, my fellow Leadership Institute colleagues and I will identify, recruit, train, mentor, and empower students, athletes, and parents across the country to become campus, community, and national Leaders for America.

Not only will these young leaders help our country right now. They will stand up for our principles for decades to come.

**[By joining me and the Leadership Institute team with your contribution to this new effort, you make a powerful difference for conservatives across the country, from college campuses to the halls of power.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/P6epIyIn4Y9hWX4_oQb9Eg~~/AARclAA~/RgRncrGSP0SUaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmVkLmxlYWRlcnNoaXBpbnN0aXR1dGUub3JnL3JnYy0wODI0MjQvP3V0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1yaWxleV9hcHBlYWwmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PVYyLVBBLVJPTi0yMDIzMTIzMFcDc3BjQgplg3IDkGXu1H22UhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)**

Thank you for your support and dedication to preserving commonsense truths and conservative principles in our country.

Stand bravely with me,

Riley Gaines

Hello Friend,

Take a moment to look around. It's like we're living out Romans 1:25 - trading the truth of God for a lie and focusing on earthly things rather than our Creator.

Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

I want to remind you, Friend, that this chaotic time is fleeting. The shadows will fade, and a new day will dawn. The King of Kings, our Savior, will return.

That's the heart of Revelation.

Each day on this earth shapes us for what's to come - a grand finale. Amidst today's messiness and uncertainty, remember the promise that our story's end is already secured, regardless of the present turmoil or future darkness.

Revelation intricately unveils where our stories lead.

It's a captivating book filled with symbols, creatures, and events yet to unfold. But remember Revelation 1:3 - there's a blessing for those who read, listen, and follow its words because the time is near.

This isn't just a prophecy; it's a blessing-filled journey.

Revelation isn't just about revealing future events; it's about revealing Jesus Christ.

When Jesus came as a man, His divine brilliance was veiled by humanity. It's like dimming a lamp's light. But when He returns, that veil will lift, and we'll see His true glory. That's Revelation's essence.

As the great reveal approaches, I'm here to guide you and your loved ones through the remarkable events preceding the revelation of our King.

In my brand-new book, _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ , I tackle five common questions about the end times. We'll delve into:

1\. America's Fate: Will America stand for Christ or fall for the Antichrist?
2\. The Day of the Lord: How should we live in anticipation of this apocalyptic event?
3\. The Marriage of the Lamb: What unfolds before and after the rapture?
4\. Gog and Magog: How can we honor God in our lives amid their appearance?
5\. The Tree of Life: What's the significance of this tree in the New Jerusalem?

Understanding these mysteries will anchor you in hope, bolster your trust in God's promises, and equip you to share with the unsure.

In addition to this new book, I would like to share with you "The Major Characters of the End Times," as a token of my gratitude for your support. Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. ## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=bb2b8dfe2d5a411f8f7492167b19e54c&_e=vjDL-oU1phh77GKSGIb9gUoa2jBIVI4PFsgyDVJsToudTLilE3Kfj8ClZ2ML8_70qnZymUpD3kwD1gpBEkOu4a2kNxgZBeyTJDi2CVt_vngVJ4c-pLhvEsnZidXIB27W7wyZJ6pEbVQMfOWEjLogmkJJdO_JRS1Iki9ERhSN--nNRGOUwVTpMkLunD8ThEew-w8T7LDCY55qJEJBFWhS2Dxh3NvMFe2wMzfxy1LnS4rKHLVXtL9KjsOrbTCxcVD-lKxa_DrRo_fupkZ6UnD_cm0CWuAPlKTAiqZDlJt8EBhxl0KQ6hmiw3sBfuAtPepA4BukCmlqMlAFx5LPzxdho01y6leB13itki-hQ3hgLULG36GRTejlGG0Xf5zBX1KGWPexjawUoeLBqUl8w1020yZixlBSem-EMORncC7X-OE%3D) [NO](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=bb2b8dfe2d5a411f8f7492167b19e54c&_e=vjDL-oU1phh77GKSGIb9gUoa2jBIVI4PFsgyDVJsToudTLilE3Kfj8ClZ2ML8_70qnZymUpD3kwD1gpBEkOu4a2kNxgZBeyTJDi2CVt_vngVJ4c-pLhvEsnZidXIB27W7wyZJ6pEbVQMfOWEjLogmkJJdO_JRS1Iki9ERhSN--nNRGOUwVTpMkLunD8ThEew-w8T7LDCY55qJEJBFWhS2Dxh3NvMFe2wMzfxy1LnS4rKHLVXtL9KjsOrbTCxcVD-jb1UB58jRB3dNJBcX6_7hU7GzEf8SzZNMlznDRbOZkiTWnFyifc_Y1FYJBZvt_5vjuc1GrdHXZp3kk8XaNTzun5DGnmSdmQM3MfKrAxzweEn5wgmqIuIZb_0Cv_tb4Pdqebw9yOJry3rfnxOZPbUwCoRTyxGcgj696qbK7v3sOE%3D) For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. * **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. | | Dear Friend,

In America, various industries have close ties to government regulators.

The pharmaceutical industry is one of the most notable and most troubling.

Last year alone, "Big Pharma" spent over $373 million on lobbying--much more than any other industry.

While the Constitution certainly protects the rights to free speech and to petition the government, it was never intended to grant the special privileges that are characteristic of today's bureaucratic, administrative state.

In addition, Big Pharma's reputation has come under attack in the wake of America's opioid epidemic--since 1999, more than 600,000 people have died from opioid overdoses in the U.S. and Canada alone--and the COVID pandemic.

Given these current controversies, we decided to host a conference to consider the rise of Big Pharma, its role in the declining state of American health, and ideas for reform.

**The result is a free online video series that reveals the truth about Big Pharma.**

When you watch this free video series, you'll learn about the collaboration between the federal government and pharmaceutical companies, the content of the "Pfizer documents," and the origins of Big Pharma and the opioid epidemic.

You'll also gain valuable insights into Anthony Fauci and the public health establishment from Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.

**You can receive instant access to this free video series right now using this secure link:**

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/big-pharma-cca/](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=fed6a356ec3f4bf7b0903af7805b6707&_e=t76Pq8d-OWy8ScYA7Ruf-2KR_CIJmFx2z0_3BtEIVP0WAPQfXX2O6r47ns-lTQMjrbB5-6In9A3F5rUE-zoZz7GOOzQof8ZlNqyA8dFg28P4fmhXorEQjto1twr9A4c0xj35mJbyicVoSJ07pWImwOak6jc09yR-XDeo5j23lds903FadsqvmDDiMdxJnD0EJ7FsaWsyR1MSjMkrlqxwLDdJ8LOLFfql2-BX7zCYswnwX67DByfaKNhDmYVVJBYCn8qwnJVTxJn_lbnN_sRVXMFrS8Hmpwsh7hZ72M3tZiQ1afiXBE7RfGTMWndT1nIMr2_y2rkCDJBvplfbG2bMmNOVwuz5wOiFBt1jQvSb05IosieUT9_648VNw_S9Z733)**

subject: Three years in America
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/successsequence-11571530?e=5703353baa)
