| |
---
| Dear Friend,

**I arrived in Mississippi exactly three years ago today, and I am as excited to be here as I was that first day.**

With so many negative stories in the news media, and progressive pundits constantly talking America down, I wanted to share with you half a dozen things I love about living in your country.

**1. Mississippi. **

**I love living right here in Mississippi.** Yes, it was a big change from London, but my family and I love it.
---
|
---
| Bizarrely, there is a certain sort of progressive in our state that is never happier than when moaning about Mississippi. Ignore them. **If living in America makes me feel that I’ve won the lottery of life, having the good fortune to be in the 20 th state of the Union makes me feel like I drew the winning powerball. **

**2\. Optimism.**

**Americans are, in my opinion, the most optimistic people on the planet.** This is a country where people believe that tomorrow will be better than today, and that next year will be better than the last. By and large, they are right.

This optimism is, I suspect, one of the secrets of American success. **Don’t ever lose it!**
---
|
---
_Crumble is an immigrant._
| **3\. Patriotism.**

**Americans, for the most part, have an uncomplicated and infectious love of their country. **

Over in Europe, elite opinion sneers at those who love their country. Chinese patriotism seems to me to often be less about love for China and more about an aggressive form of ethno-nationalism.

**In America, by contrast, anyone can become American if they subscribe to a set of ideals. This, to me, still feels like magic.**

**4\. Gratitude.**

One of the keys to living a happy life, I was brought up to believe, is a sense of gratitude. **Americans not only have lots to be grateful for, but I believe show enormous gratitude for what they have. (You even have a national holiday called “Thanksgiving”!)**

Everyone living in America today is the beneficiary of good choices made by those who came before us. Some of the best choices ever were made in a courthouse in Philadelphia in 1787. Every American today is a direct beneficiary.
---
|
---
| **5\. Belief.**

America, or at least the southern part of it, has lots of full churches. **In London, people would ask me if I went to church. In Mississippi, people ask me where I go to church.**

GK Chesterton once observed that when a man loses faith in the divine, he does not believe in nothing, but becomes capable of believing anything.

The cult of climate change, and ‘woke’ ideology, it seems to me to have become secular belief systems for people that lack any other faith. **I am not sure that faith in either Greta or Gaia will provide people with much metaphysical comfort. (Which could be why they never seem very happy.) **

**6\. My job.**

**I love working for the Mississippi Center for Public Policy, our state’s unashamedly conservative think tank.** MCPP believes in low taxes, limited government and individual freedom.

Over the past three years, thanks to your support, MCPP has been able to achieve some big wins. MCPP helped lead the fight to slash the state income tax, introduce a law to combat Critical Race theory and deregulate the labor market. **Mississippi is, I believe, closer than ever to achieving universal school choice, healthcare reform and further reductions in tax.**

---
|
---
_Conservative ideas are infectious._
| So, are there any downsides to living in America, I am sometimes asked?

**I think America is brilliant (as we Brits say).** But the US would be even more brilliant if you made a couple of very minor changes. Firstly, you need to do hot tea properly. Second, you could do with a few more roundabouts – the perfect small state traffic management solution.
---
|
---
| **Oh, and the tune you guys sing to “Away in a Manager” is wrong** (Don’t ask me to sing you the right version). But apart from that, I would not change a thing.

Thanks for having me. It is wonderful to be here.
---

---

Warm regards,

Douglas Carswell

Friend,
There has been a lot of media chatter lately about President Biden's poll numbers and the up and down prediction game for 2024. What has gotten short shrift in all the noise about politics? Donald Trump's very upfront and very clear message that he intends to operate outside the law if he is elected again next November.
Among other notable examples, including Trump saying outright that he would "only" act like a dictator "on Day One," is the following post Trump made on his social media network:
---
[](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001-2h-0zOaRdG1m2YbHSYWFXd0J69_7zk3rDx34t35xkk12qivy9HHr3IlgNKSYsZU68UJhAX32C_mw8tqz1QnO7ibDjdtO_1TFtxeLRELE1HHbRGruod-WcLQIhn4fWRrR-snQlDRzReDv41TSTiknKT6ty4VDoStoSQ41-5iBBu3JpCUlrgGXwgtXUB0Jd-HMqfEBwRDz8Q=&c=gd01n9QeK8bt1aRzNRTwmCX5L0EZc3rnBlBOT_tpPSq4998fTREqZA==&ch=X2mU4O0izFIiz50BvrtdqwdiQ-hBQj1NV3VT3HWjr5ARy8OIcLPmPw==)

This graphic is a representation of a single word used by 1,000 likely voters to describe what they think Trump and President Biden want out of a second term. Trump's word cloud emphasizes the following words and major themes:
POWER REVENGE DICTATOR DICTATORSHIP
Notably, "freedom," "democracy," and "peace" (prominent in President Biden's word cloud) require a magnifying glass to see. And Trump is more than ok with this: he seems to relish the idea of using the most powerful job in the world to exact revenge on political opponents--precisely the way dictators and fascist leaders have done in the past.
I am not running against Donald Trump, but I am running against a staunch Trump backer and MAGA proponent who will eagerly do Trump's bidding--without question.
Ohio voters are fed up with this anti-democratic agenda and are fighting back.
[I can win this race if we raise the resources to organize pro-democracy voters and communicate the stakes of this election. Team: Here at Team Stelson HQ, we’re racing against the clock to raise $30k for Janelle Stelson’s bid for Congress before tomorrow at midnight. And the fact of the matter is, **we’re 12% behind where we should be right now.** We’re a little stressed!

But we’ll be real with you for a second: We know you’re getting a lot of emails asking for money this week from a lot of different candidates and politicians. So we wanted to take just a minute to explain why this deadline **_actually matters._**

([If you hate Scott Perry or want to support a Democrat with strong values like Janelle, you can donate here.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76074002/446586107/-398252547?source=SBD_JS_EM_FR_123023_EOQ5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3MTMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiODk5MjQ5ODgtMTNhNy1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIxZjU0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=ECRQP2vQLCwYpyMUyCLqWe3MJ8luIlhgr38sajiU6As=) But if you need to be convinced, read on...)

**So what are the stakes?**
Just last week, Janelle’s opponent Scott Perry was ordered to turn over his cell phone to federal prosecutors. They’re investigating his cell phone because he conspired with Trump to throw out our votes and tried to overthrow the government on January 6th. He’s also in favor of a national abortion ban! Scott Perry is a slimy politician, and PA-10 deserves better. Period.

**Why does this deadline matter?**
This deadline is a big deal because it’s **_the_** last fundraising push before the on year — the year that we’re going to beat Scott Perry. It’s a big deal too because this end-of-quarter deadline is what we call an FEC deadline. That means that after our Sunday at midnight deadline, the amount of money we raised will go PUBLIC, and if national Republican and dark money groups think Janelle looks vulnerable, they’re going to give Scott Perry _even more_ of their dirty dollars! [We can’t let that happen.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76074003/446586108/-398252547?source=SBD_JS_EM_FR_123023_EOQ5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3MTMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiODk5MjQ5ODgtMTNhNy1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIxZjU0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=ECRQP2vQLCwYpyMUyCLqWe3MJ8luIlhgr38sajiU6As=)

**And where is my money going?**
Your generous donation would help Janelle pay her staffers, help buy door knocking literature and water bottles for volunteers. Your donation helps pay for the software we need to target the right voters so that Janelle can reach out and share her story. And your donation helps us share Janelle’s powerful message far and wide across PA-10.

_So did we convince you, team?_[ If you’re on board in our efforts to oust Scott Perry and send Janelle to fight for us in Congress, donate $10, $25 or even $50 right now.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76074004/446586109/-398252547?amount=50&source=SBD_JS_EM_FR_123023_EOQ5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3MTMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiODk5MjQ5ODgtMTNhNy1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIxZjU0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=ECRQP2vQLCwYpyMUyCLqWe3MJ8luIlhgr38sajiU6As=) | If you've stored your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will process now.

---
Peter, It’s George Sorensen, Eric’s father. 15 years ago, on the night Barack Obama was first elected president, I sat down with Eric for “the talk.” Any member of the LGBTQ+ community, and truthfully any parent of a member of the LGBTQ+ community, can understand just how uniquely fragile those conversations can be. Someone is bearing their soul to be the most authentic person, and to truly see them for who they are isn’t always easy when you have so much history knowing them in another way. Amid the euphoria of the evening, I pulled Eric aside and sat him down. I don’t think he knew quite what I was going to say. I searched for the words, and let it out:
---
“You know my political party up to this point, but now is the time for me to vote for the people who are going to do better for my kids and grandkids.”
---
Eric jerked forward and gave me a great big hug. Then his mom had to join in:

clean_body: | | | Peter, It’s George Sorensen, Eric’s father. 15 years ago, on the night Barack Obama was first elected president, I sat down with Eric for “the talk.” Any member of the LGBTQ+ community, and truthfully any parent of a member of the LGBTQ+ community, can understand just how uniquely fragile those conversations can be. Someone is bearing their soul to be the most authentic person, and to truly see them for who they are isn’t always easy when you have so much history knowing them in another way. Amid the euphoria of the evening, I pulled Eric aside and sat him down. I don’t think he knew quite what I was going to say. I searched for the words, and let it out: “You know my political party up to this point, but now is the time for me to vote for the people who are going to do better for my kids and grandkids.” Eric jerked forward and gave me a great big hug. Then his mom had to join in: “Eric, I’ve been voting for you a lot longer.” Fifteen years later, my son is the first openly out LGBTQ+ person ever elected to represent our state in Congress. And I couldn’t be prouder. Eric is one of the most compassionate people I’ve ever met, brimming with the belief that those who hate can be filled with love. And the change we seek can’t just be expected, but created by all of us as one part of one community. subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
The survey will only take a few moments of your time
188d92cdddd40f90da47bc74ea2ba8fb
This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/cXSrwt1cDxvDJsEpNjSEHw~~/AARclAA~/RgRncs3QP0SoaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L2RlcGFydG1lbnQtb2YtanVzdGljZS1zdXJ2ZXkvP3NjPTAxMDQwTjAyNDJMMEFET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1kb2pzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtUk9OLTIwMjMxMjMwVwNzcGNCCmWDjh-QZcIrH5lSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/cXSrwt1cDxvDJsEpNjSEHw~~/AARclAA~/RgRncs3QP0SoaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L2RlcGFydG1lbnQtb2YtanVzdGljZS1zdXJ2ZXkvP3NjPTAxMDQwTjAyNDJMMEFET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1kb2pzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtUk9OLTIwMjMxMjMwVwNzcGNCCmWDjh-QZcIrH5lSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/cXSrwt1cDxvDJsEpNjSEHw~~/AARclAA~/RgRncs3QP0SoaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L2RlcGFydG1lbnQtb2YtanVzdGljZS1zdXJ2ZXkvP3NjPTAxMDQwTjAyNDJMMEFET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1kb2pzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtUk9OLTIwMjMxMjMwVwNzcGNCCmWDjh-QZcIrH5lSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| Restore Our Nation

I’m going to tell you something most organizations wouldn’t admit. I look at the stats of these emails, and the truth is, over 99.98% of people who receive this message won’t donate. And on a typical day, 89% won’t even open it. Maybe we’ll get lucky and they’ll scroll through for a few seconds, but more likely than not this email will get deleted and they’ll never think about it again. **I’m asking if you can make a different choice — a decision to make a year-end gift to Fair Fight.** The amount we’re able to raise before the ball drops is directly tied to how much we can fund our programs to protect the freedom to vote in the year ahead. And you don’t need me to tell you how critical next year’s elections will be. We need to make sure voters can make their voices heard, free from voter suppression. Peter, with fewer than 48 hours left in 2023, I wanted to reach out to thank you once again for an amazing year!

I’m running to be your next Attorney General because Pennsylvania needs a true People’s Lawyer. [**Before I tell you exactly what that means and why it matters, can you chip in $10 to help me meet my fundraising goal before MIDNIGHT tomorrow?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76079945/446597423/-2044453883?amount=10&source=EM_NBI_KBG_20231230_FR_Countdown_0_1 Score_KBG_NA_NA_EOY3&refcode2=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDYzMjEiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMTVkY2U5M2YtMWNhNy1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIxZjU0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=vl1Ju23wftQXYRFIi-MwnxMySeXnFnIsvbjOMW5ji6s=)

**I don’t like boxes.** I don’t like being put into them; I don’t like putting other people into them; and I don’t like systems that check them off to measure success.

My years of experience as a Chief Defender taught me how to develop innovative solutions to the problems plaguing our system — and I’ve never taken a one-size-fits-all approach to the challenges I face.

I plan to approach my role as Pennsylvania’s Attorney General in the same way. For example:
* Truly reforming **criminal justice** involves holding accountable those who break the law AND developing systems that address the social drivers of those crimes.
* Providing access to **safe abortion care** is going to require an intricate understanding of the law AND experience working WITH communities to find safe solutions that people trust.
* Advancing **equity initiatives** is good for the business community AND those who have been pushed back behind the starting line.
* Understanding **healthcare access** is a human rights issue AND an economic security issue.
* Protecting **free and fair elections** means getting people to the polls AND defending your vote from those who discount it.
* Making **education investments** means creating safe learning environments AND stopping the school to prison pipeline.

The communities I’ve visited across the commonwealth are so diverse and varied and so are the problems they face. We can no longer afford leaders who fit these communities and people in boxes.

That’s why there is no candidate more equipped to lead the Attorney General’s office on Day ONE than I am, Peter.

[**So I’m asking you to support my campaign with a donation of $10 or any amount right now to help me crush my end-of-year fundraising goal. clean_body: As Attorney General, Keir will take on powerful special interests who treat vulnerable people unfairly, from corporate polluters, opioid manufacturers, to predatory lenders. Keir will always fight for fairness, opportunity and justice. If you’d like to unsubscribe, | | Peter, with fewer than 48 hours left in 2023, I wanted to reach out to thank you once again for an amazing year! I’m running to be your next Attorney General because Pennsylvania needs a true People’s Lawyer. ScoreKBGNANAEOY3&refcode2=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDYzMjEiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMTVkY2U5M2YtMWNhNy1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIxZjU0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=vl1Ju23wftQXYRFIi-MwnxMySeXnFnIsvbjOMW5ji6s= I don’t like boxes. I don’t like being put into them; I don’t like putting other people into them; and I don’t like systems that check them off to measure success. My years of experience as a Chief Defender taught me how to develop innovative solutions to the problems plaguing our system — and I’ve never taken a one-size-fits-all approach to the challenges I face. I plan to approach my role as Pennsylvania’s Attorney General in the same way. For example: Truly reforming criminal justice involves holding accountable those who break the law AND developing systems that address the social drivers of those crimes. Providing access to safe abortion care is going to require an intricate understanding of the law AND experience working WITH communities to find safe solutions that people trust. Advancing equity initiatives is good for the business community AND those who have been pushed back behind the starting line. Understanding healthcare access is a human rights issue AND an economic security issue. Protecting free and fair elections means getting people to the polls AND defending your vote from those who discount it. Making education investments means creating safe learning environments AND stopping the school to prison pipeline. The communities I’ve visited across the commonwealth are so diverse and varied and so are the problems they face. We can no longer afford leaders who fit these communities and people in boxes. That’s why there is no candidate more equipped to lead the Attorney General’s office on Day ONE than I am, Peter. If you have the time to keep reading, I hope that you'll take a moment to look back on the past year with me and celebrate our wins.
This year, we really got to work. I introduced legislation to create a national paid leave program — legislation that I first introduced 10 years ago, and have continued to advocate for since then. You immediately rallied behind me, voicing your support for this long-overdue legislation. **And today, support for paid family leave is higher than ever before** — including 85% of all voters in battleground states! Thank you for making this possible.
Later this year, **I released my Strategic Plan on Aging to make sure that our seniors can retire with dignity and financial stability.** From expanding existing programs like Medicare to helping more seniors remain in their homes, these proposals would drastically improve the quality of life for millions of seniors. Thank you for supporting my work to make this happen.
I'm also incredibly grateful for the outpouring of support from this grassroots team after **I introduced a resolution to finally certify the Equal Rights Amendment.****** This amendment would establish protections against gender-based discrimination in our Constitution, once and for all, giving us a legal basis to restore reproductive rights. Activists have been fighting for the ERA for 100 years, and it is truly an honor to carry forward their work today. Thank you for standing beside me in the fight for gender equity and reproductive freedom.
Lastly, I fought tirelessly to make sure that the National Defense Authorization Act included a pay increase for service members, investments to clean up toxic PFAS contamination and funding for hundreds of spots in my brand-new cyber security academy at over 400 schools. Thank you for helping me ensure that our veterans and service members get the benefits they deserve.

There have been so many other moments when you've stood beside me, and I am grateful for every single one of them. But our fight for progress is far from over. And now, Democrats are heading into one of the most difficult election years in recent memory.
Here in New York, Republicans just had their best election cycle in years. Now, they're directly targeting my seat. With a narrow 51-49 majority, we cannot afford to show any signs of weakness. **Missing my final end-of-quarter goal before the election year would be sending a crystal clear message to the GOP that this seat is up for grabs****.[So please, will you donate $5 or whatever you can spare before 11:59 p.m. to help me continue our fight for progress in 2024? Friends,
Tomorrow at midnight we face our final FEC fundraising deadline before we enter the election year. A lot of people are going to be watching to see what numbers we report – everyone from our allies to the media to our Republican opponents.
Our campaign has an ambitious goal to meet before midnight tomorrow. So we're hoping to earn 1,000 donations TODAY in order to stay on pace to hit our goal by the time the deadline ends. We know this is a lot to shoot for – but this grassroots team has proven time and again that, when push comes to shove, we can rise to the challenge.
As you know, Elissa isn't accepting any corporate PAC money. Instead, she's counting on lots of people chipping in to ensure our campaign has the resources to defend this open Senate seat. That's why we need to ask:
[**Can you make a $3 contribution to Elissa Slotkin's campaign today to help reach our daily goal of 1,000 donations? Every donation makes a huge difference before tomorrow's FEC deadline.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-dec23.ZG_uWI&refcode=em231230-1-tt&t=2&akid=974%2E135344%2EqK55ZU)**

Peter, 2023 is coming to a close fast now. We’ll ring in the New Year tomorrow evening.

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter -

At the end of this email, I'm going to ask you to [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231230-1-io.tKTuly&refcode=em20231230-32552&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1001&akid=32552%2E1203867%2EJJlwY7 ]split a contribution
— of $3 or anything you can — between Justice Democrats and
my re-election campaign. Before I do, I hope you'll give me a minute of
your time to explain why your support is so important.

Here's the deal, Peter:

December is an important month for political campaigns across the country,
but that's especially true for ones like ours, who are powered by lots and
lots of small-dollar, grassroots contributions, chipped in by people
giving what they can.

That's because at the end of the month, we're facing an official FEC
fundraising deadline — the final one before 2024, when this race will
truly begin to heat up.

We've written to you about these deadlines before, but I mean it when I
say this is a big one. In the days after this deadline passes, our team is
legally required to publicly report our fundraising numbers for the year.

That means how much we've raised, but more importantly, how many
individual contributions we've received. Good or bad, no matter what, for
all to see.

I can guarantee you that everyone — from AIPAC and the right-wing super
PACs to our primary challengers and the media — will be among the very
first looking through the receipts.

They're going to use these public reports to see if our movement is
showing any signs of weakness, or if we have the grassroots strength to
take them on and fight back as we've always done.

The only way we're funding this campaign is together, and we need to
report the strongest numbers we possibly can to show there is nothing that
will slow us down.

That's why your support, Peter
— along with the support of countless progressives standing in solidarity
all across the country — is so important. Especially today.

So please:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231230-1-io.tKTuly&refcode=em20231230-32552&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1002&akid=32552%2E1203867%2EJJlwY7 ]Can you split a contribution — of $3 or any amount you
can — to stand with Justice Democrats and me today? Each and every
contribution, no matter the size, means so much ahead of tomorrow's FEC
deadline.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231230-1-io.tKTuly&refcode=em20231230-32552&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1021&akid=32552%2E1203867%2EJJlwY7 ]Contribute $3

When I think of the many, many reasons I'm so proud of our movement, one
of them is the way we fund our campaigns. I hope you're proud of that
too, Peter.

Thanks for chipping in, and for everything you do.

In solidarity,

Ilhan

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time.

There are other ways to make an impact in support of peace and equality in
Israel and Palestine: please urge your member of Congress to support a
ceasefire through [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139873?t=1022&akid=32552%2E1203867%2EJJlwY7 ]Adalah Justice Project’s petition or by calling them
using [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139874?t=1023&akid=32552%2E1203867%2EJJlwY7 ]Jewish Voice for Peace’s dialer here. Your voice matters in this
critical moment.

clean_body: [1]Justice Democrats Peter - At the end of this email, I'm going to ask you to [ ]split a contribution — of $3 or anything you can — between Justice Democrats and my re-election campaign. Before I do, I hope you'll give me a minute of your time to explain why your support is so important. Here's the deal, Peter: December is an important month for political campaigns across the country, but that's especially true for ones like ours, who are powered by lots and lots of small-dollar, grassroots contributions, chipped in by people giving what they can. That's because at the end of the month, we're facing an official FEC fundraising deadline — the final one before 2024, when this race will truly begin to heat up. We've written to you about these deadlines before, but I mean it when I say this is a big one. In the days after this deadline passes, our team is legally required to publicly report our fundraising numbers for the year. That means how much we've raised, but more importantly, how many individual contributions we've received. Good or bad, no matter what, for all to see. I can guarantee you that everyone — from AIPAC and the right-wing super PACs to our primary challengers and the media — will be among the very first looking through the receipts. They're going to use these public reports to see if our movement is showing any signs of weakness, or if we have the grassroots strength to take them on and fight back as we've always done. The only way we're funding this campaign is together, and we need to report the strongest numbers we possibly can to show there is nothing that will slow us down. That's why your support, Peter — along with the support of countless progressives standing in solidarity all across the country — is so important. Especially today. So please: [ ]Can you split a contribution — of $3 or any amount you can — to stand with Justice Democrats and me today? Each and every contribution, no matter the size, means so much ahead of tomorrow's FEC deadline. [ ]Contribute $3 When I think of the many, many reasons I'm so proud of our movement, one of them is the way we fund our campaigns. I hope you're proud of that too, Peter. Thanks for chipping in, and for everything you do. In solidarity, Ilhan Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that this is a difficult time. There are other ways to make an impact in support of peace and equality in Israel and Palestine: please urge your member of Congress to support a ceasefire through [ ]Adalah Justice Project’s petition or by calling them using [ ]Jewish Voice for Peace’s dialer here. body:

Dear Friend,
Tomorrow is New Year’s Eve, the final day of 2023, and we’re asking for your help to reach our online fundraising goal before midnight tomorrow!
We’re also sharing the top 3 reasons to support Shamaine Daniels for Congress. So far, we’ve talked about Shamaine’s experience as an elected official with deep connections to the community, and her lifelong dedication to our Democratic values.
T oday, we present the NUMBER 1 reason to support our campaign - SHAMAINE DANIELS CAN WIN.
At the end of the day, this campaign is about defeating insurrectionist Republican Congressman Scott Perry, one of the most dangerous members of Congress. Perry is an extremist, and until very recently, the leader of the pro-MAGA House Freedom Caucus. He played a central role in Donald Trump’s plot to overturn the 2020 election, and the details of that are becoming clearer every day. It is essential that we defeat Scott Perry next year, and that means nominating a Democrat who can defeat him.
If you already know why Shamaine Daniels is the best candidate to defeat Scott Perry in 2024, CLICK HERE to make a contribution to help us reach our online fundraising goal before midnight tomorrow! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
In 2022, Shamaine challenged Scott Perry (before it was such a popular thing to do). Unfortunately, National Democrats did not target PA-10 in 2022, putting our campaign at a significant fundraising disadvantage. Despite the lack of national support, Shamaine raised over $400,000 from grassroots donors, like you, and shocked everyone by capturing 46.17% of the vote.
Why was that performance so impressive? In 2018 and 2020, PA-10 was a national target, and the Democratic nominees raised and spent over $3 Million and $4 Million respectively–matching and outspending what Scott Perry spent. With one-tenth of the resources and after the district shifted 4% towards the Republicans after redistricting, Shamaine was able to capture nearly the same percentage of the vote. This means that her connections to the voters of the district are authentic and that folks know and trust her. It means she starts the race with a base of support that no other Democratic nominee before, or candidate now, has.
The Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee (DCCC) has already announced that PA-10 is among their top national targets in 2024. That means that next year, we will have the resources we need to defeat Perry. Shamaine is the only Democratic candidate positioned to build on her past success and finish the job.
With the help of supporters like you, we held Scott Perry’s feet to the fire for his role in the attempted insurrection, and we did it without the support of National Democrats (for a quick reminder, check out one of our 2022 campaign ads below). Because of our hard work and success in 2022, National Democrats are correcting their mistake and targeting our district. Even with their support, winning in PA-10 requires Democrats to nominate the strongest candidate. The record shows that Shamaine Daniels IS that candidate.
If you’re ready to defeat Scott Perry in 2024, we need your help today. CLICK HERE to rush a contribution to Shamaine Daniels and help us reach our online fundraising goal before midnight tomorrow, 12/31. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Thank you in advance for your support! We hope you are as excited to kickoff the 2024 election cycle as we are!
- Team Daniels

Hi Peter, Cayana here.

I joined the EMILYs List team as the Vice President of Digital nine months ago, right at the beginning of an election cycle unlike any that I, or this pro-choice community, have ever seen.

Anti-choice Republican extremists have been hard at work trying to restrict or ban abortion outright since _Roe v. Wade_ was overturned last summer. What they never expected to see was that voters have stepped up to stop them every chance they got. GOP extremism is extremely out-of-step with the _overwhelming majority_ of Americans, and we've got the nationwide election results to prove it.

2023 marked a year of incredible wins made possible by this community, and 2024 will be full of opportunities for more. If we're going to carry this year's momentum into next November, we need an air-tight gameplan.

This email is longer than usual, but I promise what you read here won’t be like anything else you see from any other campaign emailing you today. **[So before I ask you to chip in your first donation before our major end-of-quarter deadline tomorrow,](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/40577?refcode=em20231230-4495&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=4495%2E614464%2EyAqVr6) will you please give me a moment to explain?**
**[ADD A DONATION NOW](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/40577?refcode=em20231230-4495&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=4495%2E614464%2EyAqVr6)**
How a candidate funds their campaign does more than just influence how they pay for staff, ads, and organizing. It has a direct impact on both our message and who we actually serve in office. **Any politician or pundit who tells you otherwise is lying — and I have the receipts.**
Despite virtually every member of Congress having campaigned on making life-saving drugs more accessible, politicians who take millions of dollars from Big Pharma are still telling us we have to accept a world where people die because they have to ration their medicine.
Then we have out-of-touch elites like Josh Hawley, who have spent decades wasting our money on tax breaks and subsidies for Wall Street, Big Pharma, Big Tech, and just about everything else that’s gutting our country.
They’re willing to lie, cheat, and steal from the American people to protect the corporate PACs and mega-donors who own them — and they’ll even raise their fist to look strong before they start running from threats to our democracy.
**We don’t need any more liars or frauds like Josh Hawley in Congress.** That’s why I’m running for U.S. Senate. It’s why I’m not taking a single cent from corporate PACs. **[And it’s why I'm asking you to add a donation of whatever you can toward our people-powered campaign before our last major fundraising deadline of 2023 tomorrow. Can I count on you to help us take this seat back for working people?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/40577?refcode=em20231230-4495&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=4495%2E614464%2EyAqVr6)**

Our mission of taking power back for everyday people has earned our movement national media attention. And our commitment to running this campaign the right way, without a cent from corporate PACs, has given us the ability to run the boldest campaign in Missouri history — taking on corrupt political elites like Hawley without hesitation about some mega-donor being upset.
More than just banning insider trading among members of Congress and their families — **I’m running to put them in jail if they steal from us.**
More than just breaking up Big Pharma — **I’m running to prosecute the insulin cartels who are killing people.**
More than just fighting to codify protections for abortion access — **I’m running to end the filibuster so we can actually get it done.**
And more than just rejecting corporate PAC money — **I’m running to abolish corporate PACs altogether.**
This campaign is powered by the people because that’s exactly who I’ll work for in the U.S. Senate — I'll be accountable to real, everyday Americans, not some corporate executive or political machine. We’re throwing out their rulebook and building a grassroots movement to fundamentally change who has power in our country. **And I want you to be part of it:**

body:

These changes would disproportionately place Black, Brown, Indigenous, and LGBTQ+ immigrants in danger. Asylum is a human right. Republicans using migrants as a political pawn to increase funding for ICE and CBP — which already have a $25 BILLION annual budget — is inhumane. clean_body: We must apply pressure on Senate Democrats to reject the supplemental funding package. | | | Peter, this is urgent: Congress is currently considering a supplemental funding package that would trade fundamental human rights for more deadly walls, detention and wars. This is like nothing we’ve ever seen before. Republicans in Congress are trying to implement UNPRECEDENTED changes to our immigration policy — like an asylum ban and near-impossible conditions for asylum applicants. These changes would disproportionately place Black, Brown, Indigenous, and LGBTQ+ immigrants in danger. Asylum is a human right. Republicans using migrants as a political pawn to increase funding for ICE and CBP — which already have a $25 BILLION annual budget — is inhumane. Senate Democrats MUST stand united to defeat this proposal. It’s time for our government to invest in real solutions, not funnel more money into the deportation machine. Congress is coming back on January 9th — we need to ensure we keep up the pressure on them to reject this hateful proposal NOW. Will you chip in any amount today to help us mount pressure on Senate Democrats before a final deal is reached and billions of more dollars are spent on the deportation machine? If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | | | | Thanks for your help in this urgent moment. Julianna, United We Dream Action

body:

I hope you have enjoyed this holiday season. I hope it has been filled with
joy and spending time with loved ones. Can you believe we have 24 hours
remaining in 2023? As the year dwindles down, we are all reflecting on the
past year and preparing for the new one. For me, I will spend this time in
gratitude to you and for your support as I embark upon my campaign for NC
House District 33. I appreciate every kind word, text, call, and social
media repost. In these last 24 hours, I am personally reaching out to ask
you for your support before the end of year deadline to see if you can chip
in any amount to help meet our fundraising goals.
<https://secure.actblue.com/donate/monika-johnson-hostler-for-nc-2>

Over the years, you have stepped up to support me and believed in a shared
vision of supporting teachers, listening to families and ensuring EVERY
student in Wake County can learn and grow. In 2024, with your help, WE can
take that advocacy and vision to the state level. Your contribution gets
us a step closer to advocating for women and children at the NC General
Assembly. Together we can continue to elevate the voices of the citizens of
District 33 with a proven leader who is an advocate and understands
education policy.

There is only nine weeks until the primary and by contributing today, your
support will give the campaign a strong start for a strong finish. We
depend on grassroots support to do the following:

Þ Print yard signs, buttons, postcards and more to get the word out in
District 33.

Þ Mobilize supporters through direct mail, social media and other digital
media formats

Please, if you can make your first contribution to our campaign before
midnight on December 31, it will make a huge difference in our campaign and
to me personally.
<https://secure.actblue.com/donate/monika-johnson-hostler-for-nc-2>

Thank you again for your support.

*Donate Now!*
<https://secure.actblue.com/donate/monika-johnson-hostler-for-nc-2>

--
Monika Johnson-Hostler
Candidate for NC House District 33

body:

# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/130?refcode=em20231230&t=1&akid=778%2E62735%2EbtGc_n)
Peter,
[**Is there anything we can say to convince you to make your first donation of $5 to our grassroots, small-dollar powered campaign before the window on our final FEC deadline closes tomorrow at midnight?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hh-em-20231230?amount=5&refcode=em20231230-778&refcode2=778_62735_btGc_n&akid=778%2E62735%2EbtGc_n)
**What if we told you** that the political establishment, special interests, and big-dollar donors are already trying to take us out of this race? Hill recently turned down a bribe of $20 million in campaign funds to drop out of this race and run against Rashida Tlaib — a progressive and one of the few representatives to bravely stand up for Palestinian lives.
**What if we told you** that Hill Harper is the complete opposite of a career politician, and it’s why the political elite are so intimidated by our campaign. Hill is a single dad, small business owner, proud progressive, and is running this campaign for the everyday working person. People like his parents, grandparents, and the folks he is in community with right here in Michigan. ****

body:
In America, various industries have close ties to government regulators.

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | | [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/w2Np7UhTGk_cST2VanVjwA~~/AARclAA~/RgRncunwP0SbaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L2JpZy1waGFybWEtY2NhLz9zYz0wMDk0MU4wMjQyTDA2RE9ERUVTJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9cHJvc3BlY3RpbmcmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249YmlncGhhcm1hJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PVBBLVJPTjItMjAyMzEyMzBXA3NwY0IKZYOiO5Bl9wNQflIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)

| | Dear Friend,

In America, various industries have close ties to government regulators.

The pharmaceutical industry is one of the most notable and most troubling.

Last year alone, "Big Pharma" spent over $373 million on lobbying--much more than any other industry.

While the Constitution certainly protects the rights to free speech and to petition the government, it was never intended to grant the special privileges that are characteristic of today's bureaucratic, administrative state.

In addition, Big Pharma's reputation has come under attack in the wake of America's opioid epidemic--since 1999, more than 600,000 people have died from opioid overdoses in the U.S. and Canada alone--and the COVID pandemic.

Given these current controversies, we decided to host a conference to consider the rise of Big Pharma, its role in the declining state of American health, and ideas for reform.

**The result is a free online video series that reveals the truth about Big Pharma.**

When you watch this free video series, you'll learn about the collaboration between the federal government and pharmaceutical companies, the content of the "Pfizer documents," and the origins of Big Pharma and the opioid epidemic.

It’s been quite the year, friend! From late-night voting sessions in Washington to hosting community events in IL-13 to hear directly from folks about the issues that matter most to them, Nikki has hit the ground running during her first year in Congress. **But this should come as no surprise.** Nikki promised to work with anyone and everyone to get things done for working families across Central and Southern Illinois — and that’s exactly what she’s done. She’s introduced critical legislation, including the _LEAP Act_ to support apprenticeship and pre-apprenticeship programs, using federal tax incentives to encourage more businesses to hire apprentices and address the job skills gap, and the _Rebuild Rural America Act_ , to deliver critical funding and resources to address issues facing rural communities like limited access to health care, high-speed internet, and aging infrastructure. When Nikki wasn’t in Washington working with her colleagues to overcome partisan gridlock and make progress for the American people, she was back home in the district connecting with her constituents. From working as a labor activist to serving in Congress, Nikki has dedicated her career to improving the lives of working families everywhere, and she’s never backed down from a tough fight. While she’s busy fighting her heart out for the people of Central and Southern Illinois, it’s our job to fight just as hard to protect her seat — and trust us, **with two right-wing opponents already in the race, we’ve got a long fight ahead.** **[Our final fundraising deadline of the year is tomorrow, so we don’t have time to waste. clean_body: | It’s been quite the year, friend! From late-night voting sessions in Washington to hosting community events in IL-13 to hear directly from folks about the issues that matter most to them, Nikki has hit the ground running during her first year in Congress. But this should come as no surprise. Nikki promised to work with anyone and everyone to get things done for working families across Central and Southern Illinois — and that’s exactly what she’s done. She’s introduced critical legislation, including the LEAP Act to support apprenticeship and pre-apprenticeship programs, using federal tax incentives to encourage more businesses to hire apprentices and address the job skills gap, and the Rebuild Rural America Act , to deliver critical funding and resources to address issues facing rural communities like limited access to health care, high-speed internet, and aging infrastructure. When Nikki wasn’t in Washington working with her colleagues to overcome partisan gridlock and make progress for the American people, she was back home in the district connecting with her constituents. From working as a labor activist to serving in Congress, Nikki has dedicated her career to improving the lives of working families everywhere, and she’s never backed down from a tough fight. Hello,
In less than 48 hours, I am facing my final federally-mandated fundraising deadline of the year. **After midnight tomorrow, we’ll be required by law to file a report with the Federal Election Commission (FEC) saying how much we’ve raised and from how many donors to replace Lauren Boebert in Congress.**
This is our final FEC report before 2024, and our fundraising numbers will be closely scrutinized by everyone.
**Last year, our race was the closest race in the country. After the recount was finished, I lost to Lauren Boebert by just 546 votes.** But with the Super PACs now on notice, they are raising millions to attack me.

Kari Lake’s been crisscrossing the country since she got into the race, appearing alongside the most extreme of the MAGA crowd. She’s building national support for her campaign and raising tons of money doing it. Kyrsten Sinema hasn’t slowed down her fundraising, either. Her super-wealthy donors keep writing the big checks while she serves their interests in DC. If she jumps into this race early next year, she’ll use every dollar of it to tear Ruben down and hurt our chances at holding the Senate. As you know, this race is going to be a close one. And if we are going to keep Kari Lake out of the Senate and replace Kyrsten Sinema with someone who will prioritize Arizonans over big money donors, getting on level financial footing is essential. But Ruben cannot do it alone. The overwhelming majority of the money he raises will come from individuals like you responding to emails like this one. It's his only chance to fund a winning campaign. So with our final, most important deadline of the year coming at midnight tomorrow night, we are asking you very humbly: If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly. | | ** | | | | | | | ** Truth is, the amount of the donation isn't even as important as the donation itself. Of course, larger donations mean a lot, but no matter the amount, every donation sends a message about the strength of our campaign. Thank you in advance for chipping in to help win this seat. Friend, As we close out 2023, I want to thank the residents of the 12th congressional district for believing in me and sending me to Congress to do the people’s work. To kick off 2023, we opened three Neighborhood Service Centers in Detroit, Inkster, and Southfield. Over the last 5 years, our Neighborhood Service Centers have helped return more than $5.5 million in constituent services directly back into the hands of 8,000 residents. Through legislation passed in Congress, we’ve secured tens of millions of dollars for our district while introducing 160 bills and amendments―39 of which have successfully passed the House. **This year we also celebrated the one-year anniversary of the Congressional Mamas’ Caucus** , which is committed to advocating for working mothers and their families on issues of affordable childcare, paid family leave, Black maternal health, and economic justice. **And we continued the critical work of the Get The Lead Out Caucus that I co-founded, which is dedicated to securing clean, affordable water for everyone.** We’ve hosted over 120 events including coffee hours, town halls, resource fairs, and more. This is part of remaining rooted in community―hearing from residents advocating for clean water, clean air, utilities for all, housing for all, and so much more. The residents of the 12th district sent me to Congress to help our families get through everyday challenges. **That’s why with every bill I draft and every resolution I introduce, it’s done in partnership with members of our community, from replacing lead pipes and demanding clean air and water as a human right, to supporting workers’ rights and keeping people in their homes.** **Even as we advocate for policies that support marginalized people, there are forces that seek to maintain the unjust status quo and take me down.** Already this year, we’re seeing attack ads and attempts to manipulate my record of advocating for our residents and all vulnerable people. clean_body: Send me back to Congress to keep fighting for you. | | | Friend, As we close out 2023, I want to thank the residents of the 12th congressional district for believing in me and sending me to Congress to do the people’s work. To kick off 2023, we opened three Neighborhood Service Centers in Detroit, Inkster, and Southfield. Over the last 5 years, our Neighborhood Service Centers have helped return more than $5.5 million in constituent services directly back into the hands of 8,000 residents. Through legislation passed in Congress, we’ve secured tens of millions of dollars for our district while introducing 160 bills and amendments―39 of which have successfully passed the House. This year we also celebrated the one-year anniversary of the Congressional Mamas’ Caucus , which is committed to advocating for working mothers and their families on issues of affordable childcare, paid family leave, Black maternal health, and economic justice. And we continued the critical work of the Get The Lead Out Caucus that I co-founded, which is dedicated to securing clean, affordable water for everyone. We’ve hosted over 120 events including coffee hours, town halls, resource fairs, and more. This is part of remaining rooted in community―hearing from residents advocating for clean water, clean air, utilities for all, housing for all, and so much more. The residents of the 12th district sent me to Congress to help our families get through everyday challenges. That’s why with every bill I draft and every resolution I introduce, it’s done in partnership with members of our community, from replacing lead pipes and demanding clean air and water as a human right, to supporting workers’ rights and keeping people in their homes. Even as we advocate for policies that support marginalized people, there are forces that seek to maintain the unjust status quo and take me down. Already this year, we’re seeing attack ads and attempts to manipulate my record of advocating for our residents and all vulnerable people. Mandela Barnes

Friend, this is Sen. Brad Pfaff, and I've run in some tough races in Western and Central Wisconsin.
I know what it takes to win as a Democrat in a rural area, and I know how important it is to have a strong coalition.
When I needed help in 2020, the WI Senate Dems were there to push me over the edge in a close victory. Can you join them with a contribution today? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ssdc-email?refcode=20231230_em_fr_b1_BP_NGP]
And now thanks to the Wisconsin Supreme Court, we will finally have fairer maps in Wisconsin next year – my district will be redrawn, and so will many others across the state.
We finally have the opportunity to win a pro-choice majority in Wisconsin.
Friend, this won't be easy, but folks like me have faced tough fights before. It takes campaigning on our strong values, a lot of hard work, and a good team behind you to win.
I'm going to rely on the Wisconsin Senate Dems again in my race in 2024, and so are dozens of candidates across the state. If we're going to win this majority, it'll take all of us – and giving to the Senate Democrats is the perfect way to ensure your money is best spent on defending democracy and winning a pro-choice majority.
Please, Friend, our fundraising deadline for the year is TOMORROW, and we need your support. Can you chip in any amount to support State Senate Democrats in Wisconsin? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ssdc-email?refcode=20231230_em_fr_b1_BP_NGP]

subject: IN THE NEWS: Exclusive interview with IBJ on Crouch's qualifications, what makes her stand out
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Suzanne Crouch
body:
Suzanne Crouch's extensive qualifications, rooted in 30 years of public service, uniquely position her to lead Indiana into a new era.

My extensive qualifications, rooted in 30 years of public service, uniquely position me to lead Indiana into a new era.

>From my early days as a county auditor to serving as lieutenant governor, I've dedicated my career to positively impacting Hoosiers' lives.

Read more from the IBJ below👇🏻
https://cbs4indy.com/video/in-focus-crouch-discusses-race-for-governor/9261275/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=8efaca3070-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_12_27_06_41&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8efaca3070-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
IBJ: Gubernatorial candidate Suzanne Crouch wants to stand out in the crowd (https://www.ibj.com/articles/gubernatorial-candidate-suzanne-crouch-wants-to-stand-out-in-the-crowd?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=8efaca3070-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_12_27_06_41&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8efaca3070-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
In a crowded field of candidates vying for the Republican nomination for governor, Suzanne Crouch wants to set herself apart from the pack.

That was evident during a panel discussion at the Dentons Legislative Conference in Indianapolis featuring five of the gubernatorial hopefuls looking to replace Gov. Eric Holcomb, who cannot seek reelection because of term limits.

... If Crouch wins the primary, she will be the first woman to nab the Republican nomination for governor. No woman has ever held the state’s top elected office.

Her qualifications are extensive. Next year will mark her 30th year holding public office, first as a county auditor in the 1990s, then as a state representative in 2005, and as lieutenant governor since 2017.

Leading the state’s highest elected office would be her magnum opus. But with several well-funded and qualified contenders gunning for the position, getting there is no sure thing.
Her political allies will point to her competitive spirit and ability to relate to Hoosiers across the state.

“She’s got a work ethic that is phenomenal,” said Lloyd Winnecke, the outgoing Republican mayor of Evansville and a longtime friend of Crouch. “She’s on the go and just works her tail off, and she has a level of empathy that I think is probably unique for someone who is a statewide candidate.”

She’s finding other ways to stand out. In August, she promised to eliminate the state’s income tax if elected governor, a bold proposal that some of her opponents have criticized as short-sighted.

“Special interest groups, big-spending bureaucrats, my opponents are screaming bloody murder and saying it can’t be done,” Crouch said. “But that money is not theirs, it’s yours, and you will always spend it more wisely than the government.

And when they say we can’t do it, what they’re really saying is, ‘Government needs more money. Hoosiers need less.’”
Public service

Growing up, Crouch was not the type of child who dreamed of being president or governor or mayor or even class president...She dabbled in various careers—real estate agent, stockbroker, small-business owner—before realizing she wanted something more rewarding.

Her first attempt at elected office came in 1986, when she ran for Vanderburgh County auditor, but she lost badly to an opponent who had bested her in fundraising...She ran for county auditor again in 1994, and this time she won. And she kept winning.

After serving two terms, she was elected to the Vanderburgh County Board of Commissioners, where she served as president until the end of her term in 2005.
It was at that point that her friend Vaneta Becker approached her about seeking her seat in the Indiana House of Representatives...

“She is one of the most hardworking people you’ll ever meet,” said Becker, who supports Crouch for governor. “She really keeps in mind what the people in the state think. She cares about people and what they say.”

In 2014, then-Gov. Mike Pence approached her about filling a vacancy for state auditor, an offer she initially declined. She wanted to remain connected to her constituents in Evansville, she told him, but she later reconsidered and accepted the appointment.

After Pence was named Donald Trump’s running mate in the 2016 presidential election, Holcomb was chosen as the Republican nominee for governor, and he picked Crouch as his running mate.

It wasn’t until Holcomb was reelected in 2020 that Crouch began contemplating taking the top spot, she
told IBJ (https://www.ibj.com/articles/gubernatorial-candidate-suzanne-crouch-wants-to-stand-out-in-the-crowd?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=8efaca3070-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_12_27_06_41&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8efaca3070-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) .

“It’s like everything else. It’s something that you didn’t really plan on doing.

You think about it for a while, and I thought, ‘You know, to be in a position to take what I know and the experience that I have and be able to impact policy that really changes Hoosiers’ lives is something that would be important, because at the end of the day, it’s what we do for other people that really determines our legacy.’”

Before I ask you to **__[chip in towards our $15,000 end-of-year fundraising goal,](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76114587/446679672/-52081428?refcode=mw_em_231230_1&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=Manassas&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzZWI0NGIxMy0zOGE3LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjFmNTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4l4BH5mswvzhACUAKITedbSsDPpfz9rxvY8SIKX98vI=)__** I want you to take a look at the impact **you** made this year:
* We raised over $6,000 for the Hawaii Community Foundation’s Maui Strong Fund when our friends in Hawaii were hit with horrific, deadly wildfires.
* We helped elect dozens of Democrats to the Virginia General Assembly – raising over $7,500 for them in the process.
* We’ve kickstarted Senator Kaine’s re-election campaign, giving him the support he needs early on to protect his seat and ultimately our Democratic Senate majority.

clean_body: | | | | This might be the most important email we send all year. | Friend, With the New Year fast approaching, we wanted to take a moment to reflect on the past year and the challenges that lie ahead. ✅ Louisiana’s very own, Mike Johnson, was elected as the new Speaker of the House, and he’s been off to an incredible start. ✅ Our good friend, Jeff Landry, was elected to be the next Governor, and he was joined by an all-star slate of executive officials. ✅ Thanks to Senator Cassidy’s hard work in negotiating for the bipartisan Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act, roads are safer, new bridges are being built, and Louisiana’s infrastructure is better off than it was 2 years ago. But we can’t ignore the harsh realities of the past year either... Thanks to Biden and the Democrats, we have a lot of damage to undo in 2024. ❌ Biden’s Border Crisis has fueled a fentanyl epidemic; human trafficking and cartel violence are out of control. ❌ Runaway inflation is making it more expensive than ever to pay the bills; gas and grocery prices are crushing American families. ❌ Anti-Semitism is on the rise, and Democratic leadership has been eerily quiet in the face of Hamas apologists. Friend - we have an obligation to get our country back on track next year, and that starts with CRUSHING our 2023 goals. | | | | | | If you were waiting for the right moment to contribute this year, NOW is the time. Every dollar counts,Friend. \- Team Cassidy, Finance Dept. (1) Team Cassidy PO Box 80505, Baton Rouge, LA 70898 \- =

body:
| | | [ ](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_4EuiRHvEQu_OzjBiZlAGzs2u921EReiR88ARqrt5HWpbBPunnEofCMh9dr_AFzKQUeBVAxKMNqUterg4VWLb4i6aCGximImILyiQ0RewfVg&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=123023_eoy&n=1&v=10)
---
Dear Friend, As we approach the end of the year, there's no better time to reflect on the values that truly matter – taking care of one another and working towards a brighter future. My vision for West Virginia and America is grounded in the principles of solidarity. I’m running to become the second Democratic Socialist in the U.S. Senate (after Bernie Sanders), and my vision for our nation is centered on one fundamental truth: **All that really matters is taking care of people.** I believe that programs supporting healthcare, education, care for the elderly, childcare, and even basic research at our public universities benefit all of humanity. These are not just programs; they are expressions of our collective responsibility to one another. By investing in these essential services, we ensure that no one is left behind, and we build a stronger, more equitable society. But my vision doesn't stop at our borders. **We must re-envision foreign policy, make it cooperative, not competitive.** Our current approach, violent and focused on short-term selfish goals, leaves us and the world less safe. It's time to embrace a foreign policy that seeks cooperation, fosters peace, and advances the well-being of all peoples. As the year draws to a close, we are facing an urgent challenge. I’m the only Democrat in the race to become a U.S. Senator from West Virginia. **Without our victory, Democrats will lose the control of the Senate.** We need your support. We have set an ambitious goal to raise $10,000 before midnight on December 31st, and we can't do it without you. ✨ [**Your contribution, no matter the size, will make a meaningful impact on our campaign.**](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_4EuiRHvEQu_OzjBiZlAGzs2u921EReiR88ARqrt5HWpbBPunnEofCMh9dr_AFzKQUeBVAxKMNqUterg4VWLb4i6aCGximImILyiQ0RewfVg&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=123023_eoy&n=2&v=10) ✨

I believe that programs supporting healthcare, education, care for the elderly, childcare, and even basic research at our public universities benefit all of humanity. These are not just programs; they are expressions of our collective responsibility to one another. By investing in these essential services, we ensure that no one is left behind, and we build a stronger, more equitable society. But my vision doesn't stop at our borders. We must re-envision foreign policy, make it cooperative, not competitive. Our current approach, violent and focused on short-term selfish goals, leaves us and the world less safe. It's time to embrace a foreign policy that seeks cooperation, fosters peace, and advances the well-being of all peoples. As the year draws to a close, we are facing an urgent challenge. I’m the only Democrat in the race to become a U.S. Senator from West Virginia. Without our victory, Democrats will lose the control of the Senate. We need your support. We have set an ambitious goal to raise $10,000 before midnight on December 31st, and we can't do it without you. ✨ ✨ | "DONATE" Together, we can make 2024 a year of progress, compassion, and cooperation. Thank you for standing with us in the fight for a better future. Let's make this vision a reality. Together, we can take care of one another and create a more just and equitable America. Wishing you a safe and joyful New Year! Zach Shrewsbury (D-WV), Candidate for U.S. Senate P.S. Time is running out to reach our $10,000 goal by December 31st. Zach Shrewsbury (D-WV) is running for the U.S. Senate seat as the only Democrat in the race. A native West Virginian, a Marine Corps veteran, and a grandson of a coal miner, Zach has a passion for making a difference in his community. He has seen firsthand the struggles faced by working families who are just trying to get by. Zach's military service experiences and his work as a community and climate justice organizer shaped his commitment to fighting for social and economic justice, and he's dedicated his career to making a difference in people's lives. | | | ---|---|--- Shrewsbury for Senate · PO Box 82, Fayetteville, WV 25840, United States

Our survival meats are home raised here in the states. So you know exactly where your food comes from. And as a family-owned, American business, we take a lot of pride in that. Look friend, there's no better time to claim your Ultimate Meat Survival Food Kit than now. Meat is one of the first things to go in a crisis. Wildfires, hurricanes, cyberattacks or something else. And the last thing I want for you is to miss out. Or worse, leave you and your family stuck with a subpar protein option. Here at 4Patriots, our mission is to champion freedom and self-reliance for all Americans. And with everything going on in the world, it's clear that survival food is no longer a luxury. It's a necessity. Ask anyone who's lived through a crisis. There's no warning. You won't see a big billboard that says "emergency coming in 5 days! Stock up before then." Disasters come out of nowhere. And if you aren't prepared when it hits, it's too late. I mean, just imagine standing in line at your local supermarket. Shelves picked bare. And the people who didn't prepare scrambling and hoarding what little food they can find. All while you pray there's a sliver of meat left for you and your family. This doesn't have to be you, friend. You can choose a different path. When storms come knocking at your door, you can stay safely inside with your loved ones. You'll feel great knowing you and your family have delicious shelf-stable meat ready to go. And trust me, the peace of mind that comes with that, feels incredible. To your survival, Frank Bates Patriot Headquarters P.S. Thanks to your support, we are able to provide support to important charities that help American veterans and their families. clean_body: Campaigns are a race against the clock, and each week adds a new layer to the mix before we achieve our collective victory in December of 2024. [] Hello Peter I hope you had a wonderful Holiday with family and friends! As we head into the New Year and Election 2024, I want to take a moment to update you as we continue building upon or previous gains with our new 2024 campaign. We’ve officially formed our Liz Taskforce Leadership Team, reached more supporters, and adding the finishing touches for several exciting "Community Building in 2024 and Beyond" campaign launches. These launches, together with other grassroots efforts, present several unique opportunities for my team and I to reach, meet and potentially help transform the lives of the far too many underrepresented residents in Georgia’s 12th Congressional District. We now have one more day until the end of our 2023 fundraising! As we close our financial books of 2023 and our first six weeks of building upon our previous gains, we want to finish strong by reaching our first goal – and seek your help. Are you able to express donate $50, $100, $250, or any amount today to get us closer to our goal? $25 [] $50 [] $100 [] $250 [] $300 [] Other [] YOUR VOICE, YOUR SUPPORT, AND OUR FUTURES MATTER! name: Charity Barry
subject: Let's Start the New Year Right!
body:
| | | |
---
| The Time Is Now!
---
| | |
---|---
Dear Friend,

Fresh from their Election Day wins last month in Kentucky, Ohio, and Virginia, Democrats are doubling down on their crusade for the majority in the U.S. House of Representatives.

We cannot let this happen! Here in Wisconsin, our very own Democrat incumbent Mark Pocan is leading the charge across the state. Why? Because he has never had a serious challenger in his general election. Mark Pocan could once again spend all of his time and resources helping defeat other Republican candidates in Wisconsin.

This simply must change. I am running to win the 2nd Congressional District and keep Mark Pocan on his heels here at home instead of fighting for other Democrats in Wisconsin.

By December 31st, when we file our year-end fundraising report, we must raise an additional $40,000 to prove to the National Democrats that my campaign is ready to fight for the people of our district.

So please, help us keep the People's House from becoming another soap box for the socialist agenda, and rush your Charity Barry for Congress contribution of $50, $75 or $100 to PO Box 267, Mineral Point, WI 53565!

Just a little inside baseball... Democrats know that Wisconsin is the key swing state to the national elections. Wisconsin will decide the next President of the United States. The fact that I am running an aggressive campaign in a district where even an increase of ten percent of Republican voters could make the difference in the outcome of statewide and national elections is why the National Democrats are so focused on our state.

If Republicans are going to maintain control of the House, it's important that I have enough resources to start 2024 out strong--otherwise the Democrats and Mark Pocan are going to intensify their attacks on all Wisconsin Republicans and our electoral votes!

Please help us post a strong December 31st fundraising report. Your donation to Friends of Charity Barry for $50, $75 or $100 will get us there.

Mental health and substance abuse are paramount concerns, issues that have touched my family deeply.

The Indiana Mental Health Roundtable, co-founded by me in 2021, stands testament to my dedication to reducing stigma and strengthening our mental health system.

ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT:
My approach to economic development emphasizes collaboration with local communities.

I have openly scrutinized projects like the LEAP Research and Innovation District, advocating for transparency and a bottom-up strategy.

By understanding the unique challenges of local governments, we can ensure no part of Indiana is left behind.
https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana/posts/pfbid026dGc1g8uigkoXX1sN24Gdw13bxbGsKGV2iqsm4RBR9djEnb5JqWAEqMHiUvG9WZ7l?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=ec0d565c9a-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_12_19_02_28_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c4c89d93ea-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Together, we will build a stronger Indiana for future generations.

Onward and upward,

name: Gene Karpinski, LCV
subject: We're SO close. Year-end 3X match deadline approaching >>
body:
Time sensitive

Peter - our Membership Drive deadline is a few days away, and we're reaching out because we haven't heard from you yet (renew your membership here and your contribution will be tripled https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/ebDKc930- ).

The truth is your membership matters, and it's particularly critical right now.

Here's the situation: Earlier this month, Senator Joe Manchin backed away from a climate deal after months of negotiations, choosing to side with Big Oil and Republicans. It leaves the deal one vote short -- stalling any real action in Congress for now.

In response, we're redoubling our efforts on pushing the White House to act decisively on climate. The Biden administration has massive amounts of power to curb climate pollution - but that will only happen if the environmental movement makes it happen.

Right now, we're facing a critical test: the Biden administration is weighing a plan to block all new oil and gas drilling leases on public waters.

This could be huge -- and a decision is coming. Right now, we're organizing volunteers from all over the country to flood the administration with letters, pressuring Biden to hold to his promises.

Peter -- it's your membership support that makes victory possible here. But we have to do more. A group of donors has put together a fund to triple match every contribution before Sunday's membership deadline:

Can we count on your support? Claim your membership now - it only takes $5 >> https://links.messages.lcv.

The ban on new oil and gas leases is the first of many huge environmental decisions, Peter. And right now, we're pushing for serious action on so many fronts -- including:
Setting tight standards for power plants and other major emitters of climate pollution
Placing strict limits on air pollution to safeguard all communities Expediting requirements of 100% tailpipe pollution-free new cars by 2035 and trucks by 2040
Protecting communities from hazardous and super-polluting methane Conserving 30% of our public lands and waters by 2030 Declaring a climate emergency - and so much more. The best way you can help win each and every one of these fights right now is to claim your LCV membership - all it takes is a gift of $5 or more. https://links.messages.lcv.

Thank you, thank you, thank you, Peter. This is such a critical moment for the environment, and we're so fortunate to have you on the team.

Onward,

Gene Karpinski
President
League of Conservation Voters

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. If this isn't the best email address at which to reach you, update your contact information https://www.pages08.net/leagueofconservationvoters/forms/ContactInformation?spMailingID=10387443&spUserID=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&spJobID=MTg4MDM4OTgwMAS2&spReportId=MTg4MDM4OTgwMAS2.
