Hey there,
If you’re anything like us here on Team Slotkin, then you are planning to kick off the New Year by watching our Michigan Wolverines go head-to-head against Alabama in the Rose Bowl. This is the 21st time in history the University of Michigan will play a Rose Bowl and the first time in 16 years (!) we’re headed to sunny Pasadena.
_(Though, since Elissa is the Representative for Michigan State, it’s important to note that the last time the State of Michigan was represented in the Rose Bowl was when the MSU Spartans pulled off a win against Stanford in 2014 – Go Green!)_
We know that, win or lose, the team is going to make Michiganders proud, and we’ll be cheering for them every step of the way. But before we can gear up for a day of football and screaming at our TVs – we have to hit our important end-of-quarter fundraising goal.
Much like the Wolverines, we’re going to rise to the occasion and leave it all on the field – but it’s going to take this entire team doing what we can. So, to celebrate Michigan making the Rose Bowl (and to help us hit our important end-of-quarter fundraising goal), we’re going to shamelessly ask:
[**Can you chip in $16 to help us celebrate the first time the University of Michigan will be in the Rose Bowl in 16 long years?](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/1924?c0=ebs-em-dec23.u4BGHB&refcode=em231230-2-tt&t=2&akid=975%2E135344%2EIz10nJ)**

Thank you,
Team Slotkin

I hope you will continue to follow along in our attempts to wrestle our nation back to where we belong as we approach a critical election that will determine the future of the amazing American experiment. John TeichertCandidate for U.S. Senate

# Teichert on the Trail
This year, General Teichert may have kicked his campaign off in October 2023, but the last three months have been nothing short of a whirlwind campaign for the 30+ year veteran and GOP candidate for the U.S. Senate in Maryland. Check out some of the biggest highlights from the campaign below!

[](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=34d9140f6e&e=1b1fb1ad9f)
John kicked off his campaign for Senate with an appearance on Fox 45 Baltimore, where he made the case for leadership, not politics in Washington, D.C. General Teichert discussed his background in the military, his service to his country, and his desire to continue that service as Maryland’s next United States Senator. Watch that [initial interview with Teichert here](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=f5fa4fb91d&e=1b1fb1ad9f).
[](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=0c278c0de3&e=1b1fb1ad9f)
On October 24th, General Teichert joined Jonathan Hunt on Fox News to discuss Defense Secretary Austin's deployment orders. The retired general said in part, “The things that we do to deter an adversary by demonstrating capability and will are the same things that we can use to respond to an adversary. And by posturing our forces in a better position both to deter and respond it makes it less likely we are going to need to respond to those threats.”
[](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=3d072e9b9e&e=1b1fb1ad9f)
On December 9th, General Teichert joined [Fox News](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=ae8c9f868a&e=1b1fb1ad9f) again to discuss the recent attacks on the U.S. Embassy in Baghdad. When discussing Iran’s collaboration in the attacks, John responded, “All of this that’s gone on in the last two months has been greenlit by Iran. Fortunately, there at the embassy in Baghdad there's an air defense system to help protect them. My team brought that in when I was the Senior Defense Official there in the summer of 2020. But all of these malign activities that are going on, including the 85 attacks and 70 Americans injured and one American killed, have all been prompted by an Iran that has not been deterred, and frankly has been emboldened, by the weakness of the Biden Administration for the last three years.”

[](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=eb0fbe014d&e=1b1fb1ad9f)
On Monday, November 6th, John joined [News Nation](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=4ce555556f&e=1b1fb1ad9f) to discuss the conflict in Gaza. In response to a Senate resolution, Teichert said, “All of this is about that word ‘deterrence,’ which means stopping the adversary, Iran in this case, from doing what you don’t want them to do. I think this resolution is rooted in a perceived American weakness in the region. What I mean by that is that we’ve got great asset capability that we’ve now deployed to the Middle East, as we should, but in the Iranian’s minds, there’s a question about our will – our actual will to respond if attacked or provoked because we’ve been appeasing Iran for the last three years. Ultimately this senatorial resolution would demonstrate a level of will that we haven’t seen from President Biden for the last three years.”
[](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=f650c96156&e=1b1fb1ad9f)
On November 26th. John joined Fox 5’s [On The Hill](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=d85d232923&e=1b1fb1ad9f) to discuss his bid for the U.S. Senate in Maryland, addressing key issues facing Marylanders today and how he’ll lead America in the right direction in the U.S. Senate. Teichert shared his message of leadership, not politics, by saying, “I’m a John Teichert wing. I’m a “we the people” wing. I’m an unalienable rights wing. I’m defining myself by getting out to where the people are in places like Baltimore City, Montgomery County, Prince George’s County, and helping them understand that conservative principles can meet the needs that they really care about.”
|

**ENDORSEMENT ALERTS!**
John is thrilled to have endorsements rolling in so early on in the campaign trail! John received endorsements from many honorable figures including Former Maryland Lieutenant Governor Boyd Rutherford!

| | | | | | | | | [](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=ba2efda09e&e=1b1fb1ad9f)

**Thoughts by Teichert**
**NATIONAL SECURITY** — On Tuesday, November 14th, John Teichert shared a video sharing his thoughts on Biden’s meeting with Chinese President Xi and America’s evident weakness under the Biden Administration. Watch the full video [here. ](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=1071742cd6&e=1b1fb1ad9f)
**LEADERSHIP** — On Wednesday, November 15th, John Teichert released “Enduring Another Self-Induced Crisis”, expressing his concern over the disarray and lack of leadership in Washington D.C., drastic government overspending, and the fragile economy that American families encounter every day. Read the full article [here.](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=259db9c467&e=1b1fb1ad9f)
**TERM LIMITS** — On Thursday, November 2nd, John signed a pledge to impose term limits in Congress. Read the full statement [here.](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=07a123193c&e=1b1fb1ad9f)
**CRIME** — On Monday, December 4th, General Teichert released “The Natural Result of a Pro-Criminal Society”, writing about soft-on-crime politicians and policies, and their effect on today’s crime-ridden society. Read the full article [here.](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=6071fadedc&e=1b1fb1ad9f)
**VETERANS** — On December 12th, General Teichert announced the launch of the ‘Veterans for Teichert’ coalition – the first coalition group of his campaign for the U.S Senate. The honorable group of military veterans met at a roundtable event to discuss the need for leadership, not politics, in Washington D.C. Read more about the coalition [here. ](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=86e3f87c8e&e=1b1fb1ad9f)
**EDUCATION** — December 14th, Teichert released “Our Classrooms are in Crisis”, addressing his vital concerns on the education crisis in Maryland. Teichert dives into teacher’s union overreach, poor student performance, and the lack of parent’s rights in their children’s education. Read Teichert’s full article [here](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=a8e8195632&e=1b1fb1ad9f).

The retired general said in part, “The things that we do to deter an adversary by demonstrating capability and will are the same things that we can use to respond to an adversary. And by posturing our forces in a better position both to deter and respond it makes it less likely we are going to need to respond to those threats.” On December 9th, General Teichert joined again to discuss the recent attacks on the U.S. Embassy in Baghdad. When discussing Iran’s collaboration in the attacks, John responded, “All of this that’s gone on in the last two months has been greenlit by Iran. Fortunately, there at the embassy in Baghdad there's an air defense system to help protect them. My team brought that in when I was the Senior Defense Official there in the summer of 2020. But all of these malign activities that are going on, including the 85 attacks and 70 Americans injured and one American killed, have all been prompted by an Iran that has not been deterred, and frankly has been emboldened, by the weakness of the Biden Administration for the last three years.” On Monday, November 6th, John joined to discuss the conflict in Gaza. In response to a Senate resolution, Teichert said, “All of this is about that word ‘deterrence,’ which means stopping the adversary, Iran in this case, from doing what you don’t want them to do. I think this resolution is rooted in a perceived American weakness in the region. What I mean by that is that we’ve got great asset capability that we’ve now deployed to the Middle East, as we should, but in the Iranian’s minds, there’s a question about our will – our actual will to respond if attacked or provoked because we’ve been appeasing Iran for the last three years. Ultimately this senatorial resolution would demonstrate a level of will that we haven’t seen from President Biden for the last three years.” On November 26th. Peter,

As a Navy veteran, former small business owner, and mom I feel the call to serve every single day. And four months ago we launched this campaign to serve our community.

Every day since then, we’ve worked hard to build up this team to kick Jen Kiggans out of Congress and retake the House because **it’s time to end the far-right takeover of Congress and ensure that our voices are heard.**

These lifesaving laws included a ban on assault weapons and enhancing background checks for gun sales. The majority of Americans agree, but despite that, **Fitzpatrick did what was best for himself — not Pennsylvanians and the rest of America.** Right now guns are _still_ the number one cause of death for young people. **** As Mad’s campaign manager, I need to make sure we’re doing everything we can to prepare for the intense fight ahead in 2024. Right now, that means taking a moment to connect with you before tomorrow’s end-of-year FEC public filing deadline.

| Hi there,

There’s three important things I need to talk to you about today.
1. National Republicans’ plan to eliminate—and criminalize—abortion access if they expand their majority in 2024. Despite the will of the voters, they potentially want to shut down every abortion facility in the country.

2. Part of their plan entails making sure referendums like Kansas had in 2022 never happen again.

Peter – I know my team and I have been reaching out a lot this month. I promise this one is important so I hope you’ll read the whole thing.

The GOP’s dysfunction this year has been _one of the most politically irresponsible things_ I’ve seen my entire career in office. For weeks, House business was shuttered as the MAGA Party bickered about who to elect as House Speaker.

Then, when they finally elected a Speaker, they picked one of the most despicable far-right Members of their party. **Our new House Speaker Mike Johnson once wrote in favor of criminalizing homosexuality.**

Peter, as a gay man, it is so disheartening to see these views come to the forefront of US politics time and time again. Sometimes, it feels like we’ve made no progress at all.

But I know I can’t stop fighting._For the young gay kid still in the closet, for the woman scared to have an abortion, for the advocates fighting for a cleaner world_ – **we must keep fighting.**

**And I know I’m not alone, Peter.** Because every day I see grassroots, everyday Americans fighting to push our country in the right direction: whether it’s chipping in a few bucks, voting, or speaking up against injustice.

So right now, I’m counting on this grassroots army.

A quick recap of 2023.
#
Hey, everyone!
It's hard to believe, but 2023 is almost done.
And while Republican chaos has put the 118th Congress on track to be the least productive in 100 years, here’s just some of what our movement was able to accomplish this year because of your support:
1\. We **[ended the ban on the study of psychedelics**](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/22080?t=1&akid=5562%2E2526796%2EToSsu3). A big THANK YOU to the military veterans who advocated for this amendment and who continue to fight for alternative therapies for PTSD.
2\. We **[successfully pushed the White House to create the American Climate Corps**](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/22075?t=2&akid=5562%2E2526796%2EToSsu3).
3\. We **attended over 240 community events** this year, **distributed 1,115 backpacks** to children around NYC as school started, **welcomed over 300 children** to our annual Halloween Party, **gave out 700 Thanksgiving turkeys** , and **organized 6 town halls**.
4\. We **[called on the Department of Justice to investigate Clarence Thomas for corruption**](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/22076?t=3&akid=5562%2E2526796%2EToSsu3) and were joined by senior members of the House Judiciary and Oversight Committees.
5\. We were one of the original cosponsors calling for a ceasefire, and have worked to grow that coalition to 62 strong.
6\. We organized for reproductive rights and **fundraised for five different abortion access funds across the country**.
7\. We **supported unprecedented labor movement victories**. We walked the picket line with SAG/AFTRA & WGA, UPS Teamsters, the Association of Professional Flight Attendants — and even traveled to Wentzville, Missouri to rally for the historic UAW contract.
**If you want to hear about all of our highlights from 2023, watch the video below!**[And if you can, consider joining our thousands of supporters and make a donation today to power more organizing in the year to come.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-2023eoyvideo.hiUQjv&refcode=em20231230-5562-P_FND_CTR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=5562%2E2526796%2EToSsu3)
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-2023eoyvideo.hiUQjv&refcode=em20231230-5562-P_FND_CTR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=5562%2E2526796%2EToSsu3)**[Watch the video »](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-2023eoyvideo.hiUQjv&refcode=em20231230-5562-P_FND_CTR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=6&akid=5562%2E2526796%2EToSsu3)**
Thank you, again, for all you do. I wish you all a joyous holiday season and a very Happy New Year.
Yours in service,
Alexandria
[Watch the video »](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-2023eoyvideo.hiUQjv&refcode=em20231230-5562-P_FND_CTR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=7&akid=5562%2E2526796%2EToSsu3)

From humble beginnings, Vicente was raised in a military family. Through hard work and pure ganas, Vicente aimed to make something of himself. His mother stressed to him over and over again that education was the key that will open doors of opportunities. Vicente made the decision to get his life back on track by going back to school to get his GED, working and attending classes at community college, and earning his college degree alongside other military families at the Embry Riddle Aeronautical University on the Corpus Christi Naval Air Station. Vicente has focused his practice on fighting for a level playing field for working families wronged by corporations and insurance companies evading responsibility. Through several victories for our community, Vicente recovered millions in tax dollars for South Texas school districts after shady contractors misspent millions in bond money and put our children in physical danger.

He’s working to lower prescription drug prices, protect the benefits and healthcare of seniors, and ensure that jobs and opportunities are there for all with the ganas to work.

|

This is urgent, team,

We’re seeing a disturbing pattern emerge across the country where map-manipulating Republican lawmakers are _openly defying court orders_ as a matter of course.

**FIRST:**
After the U.S. Supreme Court struck down Alabama’s congressional map for illegally diluting the power of Black voters, Alabama lawmakers ignored the Court’s mandate to enact a new, fair map. Instead, lawmakers approved a _second_ map that also discriminated against Black voters.

**THEN:**
The Court reaffirmed its decision and allowed a special master to draw a new map with two opportunity districts where Black Alabamans can elect the candidate of their choice.

**BUT NOW:**
GOP lawmakers in Georgia have taken a page out of Alabama’s book. After a court ruled that Georgia’s maps violated the Voting Rights Act, Republicans voted to enact a new set of maps that continue to discriminate against Black voters. FIRST: After the U.S. Supreme Court struck down Alabama’s congressional map for illegally diluting the power of Black voters, Alabama lawmakers ignored the Court’s mandate to enact a new, fair map. Instead, lawmakers approved a second map that also discriminated against Black voters. THEN: The Court reaffirmed its decision and allowed a special master to draw a new map with two opportunity districts where Black Alabamans can elect the candidate of their choice. BUT NOW: GOP lawmakers in Georgia have taken a page out of Alabama’s book. name: Alexandra Rojas
subject: Reflecting on 2023
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

As the end of the year and our fundraising deadline rapidly approach, I’m
reflecting on 2023 and what it meant for Justice Democrats. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231230-2.eqhgGG&refcode=em20231230-32588&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1001&akid=32588%2E1203867%2E-WrF08 ]This is a
long email, but I hope you’ll take a moment to read it and chip in to
support our critical work ahead in 2024.

2023 was a tough year in a multitude of ways.

Due to a massive fundraising slow-down, Justice Democrats found itself in
a dire financial situation earlier this year, which led to our incredibly
difficult decision to lay off nine of our twenty members of staff in July.

As an organization, we were certainly at a crossroads. But we reached out
for help from this grassroots movement, and people like you helped us
regain our footing by chipping in whatever you could. We’ll never forget
that.

Then, the horrible events beginning on October 7th took place in Israel
and Palestine, which set off months of violence and abhorrent human rights
abuses in Gaza. Israel’s right-wing government and military have
simultaneously bombed and starved millions of Palestinians, and are very
openly conducting ethnic cleansing and genocide before our very eyes. More
than 20,000 Palestinian lives have been taken, mostly women and children,
and millions more have been driven out of their homes and communities with
nowhere safe to go.

In light of this devastating violence and loss of life, our Squad of
progressives in Congress had the moral clarity and courage to be the first
to call for a ceasefire and release of all Israeli and Palestinian
hostages — and they were attacked for it.

Rashida Tlaib, the only Palestinian American member of Congress, was
formally censured in the House by her colleagues on both sides of the
aisle, simply for speaking up for Palestinians’ basic human rights. Cori
Bush, Ilhan Omar, Jamaal Bowman, Summer Lee, and others were verbally
attacked and ridiculed for their pro-peace stance, and AIPAC wasted no
time in launching attack ads against them and recruiting moderate
candidates to challenge them in the 2024 primaries as punishment.

But over these last few months, you stood by Justice Democrats and the
Squad, answering our calls for help and contributing what you could to
fuel our crucial work to fight back against our right-wing, corporate, and
establishment opponents.

The ceasefire movement has since grown stronger day by day, with the
majority of public opinion in support of a permanent ceasefire and
hundreds of thousands of people all over the world organizing protests and
marches to demand peace.

That is the power of this young, diverse, working-class movement we’ve
built together, and it’s exactly why we need to give it our all to keep it
alive in 2024 and beyond.

AIPAC has over $100,000,000 from millionaire and billionaire mega-donors
and right-wing Trump supporters who will spend anything to maintain the
status quo. Justice Democrats has you.

As we prepare for the tough primary fights ahead in 2024, we’re counting
on grassroots supporters like you to fuel our critical work to re-elect
our Squad incumbents and expand our bloc of bold progressives in Congress
— and time is running out.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231230-2.eqhgGG&refcode=em20231230-32588&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1002&akid=32588%2E1203867%2E-WrF08 ]Please, if you can afford to, make a donation of $3 or
any amount right now to help us reach our $75,000 end-of-year goal by
midnight tomorrow and power Justice Democrats into the new year.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231230-2.eqhgGG&refcode=em20231230-32588&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1021&akid=32588%2E1203867%2E-WrF08 ]Contribute $3

I can’t thank you enough for your support and solidarity during this
difficult year. 2024 will no doubt be challenging, but together, we can
and must overcome.

Deeply grateful,

Alexandra Rojas
Executive Director

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time.

There are other ways to make an impact in support of peace and equality in
Israel and Palestine: please urge your member of Congress to support a
ceasefire through [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139873?t=1022&akid=32588%2E1203867%2E-WrF08 ]Adalah Justice Project’s petition or by calling them
using [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139874?t=1023&akid=32588%2E1203867%2E-WrF08 ]Jewish Voice for Peace’s dialer here. Your voice matters in this
critical moment.

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20231230-32588-footer&t=1024&refcode2=32588_1203867_-WrF08&akid=32588%2E1203867%2E-WrF08

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://go.justicedemocrats.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1025&akid=32588%2E1203867%2E-WrF08

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76133186/446721538/-2102377403?refcode=AU_MKH_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC_20231230_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MTU3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MzQxYWI3YS01MmE3LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjFmNTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lpO4NKhWnj16l1RL0vCTy0zNM92VPLo1i74zDVZS4SE=) Aloha Peter, As the first Asian American woman elected to the Senate — and the only immigrant currently serving in the chamber — I know how important it is to speak out against injustice. **[Before I explain more below, can you add a donation before tomorrow’s critical end-of-quarter fundraising deadline?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76133187/446721539/-2102377403?refcode=AU_MKH_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC_20231230_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MTU3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MzQxYWI3YS01MmE3LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjFmNTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lpO4NKhWnj16l1RL0vCTy0zNM92VPLo1i74zDVZS4SE=) ** **Here’s a personal link to give:****[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mkh-em-dec23](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76133188/446721540/-2102377403?refcode=AU_MKH_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC_20231230_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MTU3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MzQxYWI3YS01MmE3LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjFmNTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lpO4NKhWnj16l1RL0vCTy0zNM92VPLo1i74zDVZS4SE=)** For most of my career, I engaged in this work stolidly and without much fuss. In the cultures I was raised in, we were not rewarded for speaking up, or speaking out. So I focused on doing the work, and letting the work speak for itself. This led many to say, when I began speaking out about the awful actions by the Trump Administration, and the awful behavior by Trump himself, that I had “found my voice.” **This could not be further from the truth. I chose to use my voice.** I couldn’t stand by while the Trump administration ripped children out of the arms of their parents, incited white supremacists, and packed the nation’s courts with demagogues who would later overturn _Roe v. Wade_. His bullying behavior, and his interest in tearing our country apart by our differences, instead of investing in the diversity that makes us stronger, had to be called out. This interest in exposing our differences was never limited to Donald Trump. This is the GOP’s agenda. It was there in the way they embraced calling COVID-19 “the China virus,” it was there when they spoke out against President Biden’s intention to nominate a Black woman to the Supreme Court, and it is still there now, as Republican legislatures across the country ban books that tell diverse, welcoming stories for minority and LGBTQ+ communities. **As long as Republicans — whether in the House, the Senate, or the supermajority of right wing ideologues on the Supreme Court — continue to try to tear us apart, I will continue to speak out bluntly about the danger they pose to women, the LGTBQ+ community, immigrants, and other vulnerable groups.** [**Peter, my work has always been powered by grassroots supporters like you, and I wouldn’t have it any other way. It was there in the way they embraced calling COVID-19 “the China virus,” it was there when they spoke out against President Biden’s intention to nominate a Black woman to the Supreme Court, and it is still there now, as Republican legislatures across the country ban books that tell diverse, welcoming stories for minority and LGBTQ+ communities. As long as Republicans — whether in the House, the Senate, or the supermajority of right wing ideologues on the Supreme Court — continue to try to tear us apart, I will continue to speak out bluntly about the danger they pose to women, the LGTBQ+ community, immigrants, and other vulnerable groups. = | | | **= ** | **= ** | | **= ** | **= ** | | **= ** | **= ** Thank you for reading and for supporting my work today. | Hi, it’s Jane Fonda.

As we bid farewell to 2023, I want to express my deepest gratitude for your support and dedication to the Jane Fonda Climate PAC. Your unwavering commitment to combating the climate crisis propelled our journey through a year of challenges and triumphs. In our second election cycle, we’ve grown our team and the power of our grassroots movement. Before we head into 2024, I wanted to share some reflections and key takeaways from this year with you.

I know that we could not have achieved everything we did this year without the generosity of our grassroots supporters. [_**Will you help keep up the momentum for 2024 and beyond with a contribution today?**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/76133330/446721914/931971737?refcode=BLU_EM_JANE_2023-12-30_Z&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjg1YTUxYzBhLTUzYTctZWUxMS1iZWExLTAwMjI0ODIyMWY1NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=WFIt2C2Tr8rM6J3BZneK1G0035iEGT_g59MraenWucg=)

**We elected climate champions up and down the ballot in key states across the country.** In Virginia, 13 of our 14 endorsed candidates won their State House and Senate Races. As a result, Democrats regained control of the House of Delegates and retained control of the State Senate. We dealt a major blow to the corporate polluters who backed the GOP in Virginia and set the state back on its course toward a clean energy future.

We also took the fight to races for city councils, county supervisors, and school boards across the country. With your support, we got climate candidates over the finish line in Minnesota, Illinois, California, Pennsylvania, Texas, Virginia, and Colorado.

_**I want to say a heartfelt thank you to all who contributed, volunteered, made phone calls, and invested their time to secure these victories.**_ Because of you, millions more Americans have climate champions representing them at the state and local level, fighting to build a livable future for all of us.

We also helped organize the March to End Fossil Fuels in New York City, where more than _**75,000 people**_ from different walks of life took to the streets in New York and demanded President Biden and our elected leaders make it a priority to transition away from fossil fuels towards a clean energy future. This historic moment was only possible because of the hard work of coalition organizations, frontline leaders, impacted communities, and grassroots supporters like YOU.

As we head toward one of the biggest elections of our time, I’m excited to report that our team is growing! In July, we hired a full-time Executive Director, Sarah Lane, to guide the next phase of our work.

At our annual retreat, we laid out an ambitious plan for 2024 to launch a neighbor-to-neighbor field organizing program to help elect climate champions and take on Big Oil in my home state of California. We will be scaling up our operation, hiring more staff, and recruiting more volunteers to help us knock on doors, make phone calls, and get out the vote for our climate champions.

Please know that without you, none of this would have been possible. I am incredibly grateful for your support as we fight together to end the fossil fuel industry’s stranglehold on our politics.

Looking ahead, we have so much work to do. I hope I can count on you as we head into one of the most important elections for the future of our planet.

clean_body: As we bid farewell to 2023, I want to express my deepest gratitude for your support and dedication to the Jane Fonda Climate PAC. | = | Hi, it’s Jane Fonda. As we bid farewell to 2023, I want to express my deepest gratitude for your support and dedication to the Jane Fonda Climate PAC. Your unwavering commitment to combating the climate crisis propelled our journey through a year of challenges and triumphs. In our second election cycle, we’ve grown our team and the power of our grassroots movement. Before we head into 2024, I wanted to share some reflections and key takeaways from this year with you. I know that we could not have achieved everything we did this year without the generosity of our grassroots supporters. = We elected climate champions up and down the ballot in key states across the country. In Virginia, 13 of our 14 endorsed candidates won their State House and Senate Races. As a result, Democrats regained control of the House of Delegates and retained control of the State Senate. We dealt a major blow to the corporate polluters who backed the GOP in Virginia and set the state back on its course toward a clean energy future. We also took the fight to races for city councils, county supervisors, and school boards across the country. With your support, we got climate candidates over the finish line in Minnesota, Illinois, California, Pennsylvania, Texas, Virginia, and Colorado. I want to say a heartfelt thank you to all who contributed, volunteered, made phone calls, and invested their time to secure these victories. Because of you, millions more Americans have climate champions representing them at the state and local level, fighting to build a livable future for all of us. We also helped organize the March to End Fossil Fuels in New York City, where more than 75,000 people from different walks of life took to the streets in New York and demanded President Biden and our elected leaders make it a priority to transition away from fossil fuels towards a clean energy future. This historic moment was only possible because of the hard work of coalition organizations, frontline leaders, impacted communities, and grassroots supporters like YOU. As we head toward one of the biggest elections of our time, I’m excited to report that our team is growing! In July, we hired a full-time Executive Director, Sarah Lane, to guide the next phase of our work. At our annual retreat, we laid out an ambitious plan for 2024 to launch a neighbor-to-neighbor field organizing program to help elect climate champions and take on Big Oil in my home state of California. We will be scaling up our operation, hiring more staff, and recruiting more volunteers to help us knock on doors, make phone calls, and get out the vote for our climate champions. Please know that without you, none of this would have been possible. I am incredibly grateful for your support as we fight together to end the fossil fuel industry’s stranglehold on our politics. Looking ahead, we have so much work to do. I hope I can count on you as we head into one of the most important elections for the future of our planet. = | = Let’s fight like hell, Jane Fonda = | | Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee. Friend,
There is so much at stake this election, from defeating Donald Trump (again) to unseating Jim Jordan— _the Shame of Ohio_.
The contest has become clearer the closer we get to Election Day. America must choose one of two paths ahead: democracy, with all its flaws and unpredictability; or dictatorial rule by one man who gets to live outside the law entirely, driven solely by anger and grievance and out for “revenge.” **
****But Trump cannot do any of this alone.** He needs, for now at least, ready enablers in the U.S. Congress, the seat of our democracy, to enact his toxic agenda.
That’s where someone like Jim Jordan comes in, playing a pivotal role in determining the course of our history and either the death or preservation of American freedom. **
****It doesn’t have to be like this!** We can stop Trump from taking power AND cut the legs out from under the divisive MAGA agenda by defeating Jim Jordan this election.
[**I will never give up on the people of my district, and I am asking that you fight for them like our lives and our democracy depend on it—because it just might. Hi Peter,
I wanted to reach out personally one last time before the New Year to share my reflections on 2023.
Running for Arizona’s Sixth Congressional House district again has been fantastic. (You can see some highlights from the campaign trail below!)

But first, I have to tell you: the clock is ticking down on our most important fundraising deadline of the year. We only have tomorrow at midnight to raise $5,835 more. Can you help us hit our end-of-year goal? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engel2024_foundingdonor?refcode=X_123023_EOQ_H_long_act]
Losing the race by such a small margin in 2022 was hard. We had so many incredible grassroots donors and volunteers show up for us, and we came so close to beating my Republican opponent. With the odds stacked against us, we exceeded all expectations.
When we launched this campaign in April of this year, I knew this race was going to be different.
We have always focused on the issues that hit close to home for Arizonans: defending reproductive rights, protecting our water supply, and strengthening our local economy.
But this year, we started to get national attention.
Democratic organizations realized that Juan Ciscomani, my opponent, is in one of the most vulnerable seats in the House — and that we have an incredible opportunity to flip AZ-06 blue. Now, we have more momentum in this race than we ever had in the last cycle.
The heart of this campaign is still folks like you — our grassroots donors who show up to build a better Arizona and a better country. I’ve had the joy of meeting so many of you on the campaign trail.
Peter, we need your help crossing the finish line before the end of the year. Every dollar truly makes a difference when we’re taking on Republican mega-donors. Can I count on you to donate now? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engel2024_foundingdonor?refcode=X_123023_EOQ_H_long_act]

clean_body: As we bid farewell to 2023 and brace ourselves for the monumental election year ahead, I’m emailing to ask for your support one last time. | Peter, As we bid farewell to 2023 and brace ourselves for the monumental election year ahead, I’m emailing to ask for your support one last time. This isn’t just any end-of-month ask – it’s our final push before the New Year. We’re still a bit short of hitting our crucial end-of-year fundraising goal, and we need your help to finish strong. Every dollar we raise before midnight tomorrow will lay the foundation for a strong start to 2024. Once we enter the New Year, our fundraising data for the final quarter of 2023 will be made public for the media and our opponents to scrutinize. That’s why it’s so important to hit our end-of-year fundraising goal. By contributing today, you can help show that our grassroots movement is strong, resilient, and ready to face the challenges that lie ahead in 2024. With your help, we’ll kick off the New Year with the resources needed to hold this crucial “toss-up” seat and take back our House majority. So what do you say, Peter, can I count on you to chip in $10 (or any amount) before our end-of-year fundraising deadline? disclaimer_text: Paid for by The Committee To Elect David Flippo]( "Paid for by The Committee To Elect David Flippo")
body:
A Veteran's Duty Continues | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/2ebb11b19e61/defending-our-republics-core-values?e=273c9a71fb)
---
| | [ ](https://electdavidflippo.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aba26b775663b53df718fc1a&id=bce26fd6dc&e=273c9a71fb)
---
| Hey Peter,

As we confront challenges that threaten the very core of our Republic, I am reminded of **the oath I swore as a United States Air Force officer to support and defend the Constitution** against all enemies,_foreign and domestic._

Today, I reach out to you not just as a candidate for Nevada's 4th Congressional District but as a retired Lt. Colonel and former Combat Commander who has lived by that oath every day of my service. [Will you answer the call with me?](https://electdavidflippo.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aba26b775663b53df718fc1a&id=4eb1be20da&e=273c9a71fb)
---
| [ ](https://electdavidflippo.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aba26b775663b53df718fc1a&id=5b7f77b654&e=273c9a71fb)
---
| [ ](https://electdavidflippo.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aba26b775663b53df718fc1a&id=5c52bfb97e&e=273c9a71fb)
---
| The recent ruling by the Colorado Supreme Court and Maine Secretary of State to disqualify President Donald Trump from the presidential primary ballot is not just a concern for one political party or candidate. It is a concern for every American who values the sanctity of our electoral process and the principles of our Republic.

Throughout my career, from leading several Aircraft Maintenance Squadrons to navigating the complexities of commanding a Squadron in combat, my actions were guided by a commitment to our nation's founding ideals. The same commitment now drives me to stand against any action that undermines the integrity of our elections.
---
| | [A CALL TO UPHOLD OUR CONSTIUTIONAL RIGHTS](https://electdavidflippo.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aba26b775663b53df718fc1a&id=1babf7f0a0&e=273c9a71fb "A CALL TO UPHOLD OUR CONSTIUTIONAL RIGHTS")
---
| | Peter,

This moment calls for [more than just words;](https://electdavidflippo.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aba26b775663b53df718fc1a&id=8bec5a9e61&e=273c9a71fb) it requires a collective stand against the erosion of our democratic values. The attempt to silence a major candidate through judicial overreach is an affront to the democratic process and to the Constitution I swore to defend.

Your [support](https://electdavidflippo.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aba26b775663b53df718fc1a&id=efcafadab2&e=273c9a71fb) is critical in this fight. Together, we can push back against those who seek to undermine our Republic and erode the trust in our electoral system. Let us not be deterred by these challenges but instead be motivated to safeguard the principles that have made our nation a symbol of freedom and justice.

Join me in this critical mission. Your contribution, your [voice](https://electdavidflippo.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aba26b775663b53df718fc1a&id=f15ffd7601&e=273c9a71fb), and your vote are the arsenal we need to win this fight for our nation's future.

With unwavering commitment,

Lt. Col. David Flippo
United States Air Force Ret.

**P.S. Our battlefields have changed, but our fight continues.[Join me in defending the integrity of our elections and upholding the values that define us as Americans.](https://electdavidflippo.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aba26b775663b53df718fc1a&id=f0770de035&e=273c9a71fb)**

name: Katie Porter
subject: personal update
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Senate
body:
Derek, I wanted to reach out personally to share some updates on the campaign.
While earlier polls showed us leading or just barely trailing Adam Schiff, **two December polls show Republican Steve Garvey in second place, with us in third.**
These were the first polls to show us behind our Republican opponent. Because only the top two candidates, regardless of party, advance from the primary to the November general election, **we can’t let Republican Steve Garvey be the reason we fail to advance.**
With ballots going out February 5th to all California voters, these next few weeks are critical to ensure I can keep running to represent California in the U.S. Senate.
**Our end of quarter fundraising deadline is 12/31,** and this is a marker for our campaign and the momentum we’re building. But we have to ramp up our fundraising if we’re going to win.
A super PAC has already spent $1 million on ads supporting another candidate in this race, and Adam Schiff has outraised us every quarter so far. I am the only candidate in this race who doesn’t accept corporate PAC or federal lobbyist money, so every dollar I raise comes from my supporters like you.
If you can contribute before the end of the year, I would be so appreciative! Anything you can give today will ensure I have the opportunity to build momentum and communicate with undecided voters across California before the competitive March primary.
**You can make a contribution here:[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20231230-1?refcode=20231230-2](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20231230-2?refcode=EMAO23_2_KPU_20231230_V1_F&refcode2=35653_3422442_s2N_Jh&akid=35653%2E3422442%2Es2N_Jh)**
Thank you Derek, for your past and continued support! You’re an important part of Team Porter, and I am grateful you’re on my side.
Katie

We've got just under two days before our end-of-quarter fundraising deadline, and here's the thing: we're short of where we need to be. It's powerfully important that we hit our quarterly goal and demonstrate strong support for our campaign on our public FEC report. Any sign of weakness or decline in support this quarter could act as a green light for the special interests that I’m fighting against to recruit a challenger against me and put an end to our plans for big, structural change. **I’m running for re-election in 2024 because there’s a lot we’ve got to do in order to save our country from extremists and make real change for our working families. And I’m going to keep fighting my heart out for this. But I need you by my side in order to stay in the Senate and continue this important work.[Can you please rush a donation of $28 or anything you can to help close the gap on our fundraising goal and open 2024 with strong momentum?](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/1059?amount=28&t=8&akid=1875%2E4032634%2E9bRTjY)**

In a high-stakes, competitive Senate race like Tammy’s, every number matters. Like **1%** — that’s the margin by which Republican Senator Ron Johnson won Wisconsin’s other Senate seat last year. Or **$20 million** — that’s how much GOP megamillionaire Eric Hovde has vowed to spend from his own personal fortune to defeat Tammy. Since we’re closing in on our December 31st public fundraising deadline, I did the math to see what needs to happen in order to reach our goal and start 2024 on the strongest note possible. **We’ve got about $20,000 left to raise to hit our grassroots fundraising goal, and this month, our average online donation is $22. # [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=976%2E135344%2E7kyqPh)

Hi there.
We're writing today to ask if you can make a $1 contribution to Elissa Slotkin's campaign for Senate before our FEC fundraising deadline comes to a close tomorrow at midnight.
Why $1, specifically?
$1 because Michigan is going to be one of the most expensive and competitive Senate races of the cycle.
$1 because we have set an ambitious goal of reaching 1,000 donations TODAY.
$1 because when this FEC fundraising deadline ends, we're legally required to report just how much money we've raised. So both friends and competitors will be watching what we report – and everyone will be looking to see how we stack up to our potential Republican opponents.
$1 because Elissa doesn’t take corporate PAC money and is relying on individuals like you to chip in a few bucks at a time.
It may not seem like $1 can make a huge difference in one of the most competitive and expensive Senate races in the country, but by the time you get to this point in the email, a few folks have already made their donation.
Now, we're asking you to do the same before our end-of-quarter fundraising deadline comes to a close at midnight tomorrow. [**Please use this link to contribute $1, or whatever you can afford today, to help Elissa Slotkin keep this Senate seat in Michigan blue for Democrats.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-dec23.ZG_uWI&refcode=em231230-2-tt&t=2&akid=976%2E135344%2E7kyqPh)**

A little over two years ago, I sat down for the first time to write an email like this one, directed to thousands I hadn’t met but hoped would join our cause in electing Maxwell Frost.

I knew, despite all odds, that grassroots donations were powerful enough to elect the leader we deserved.

I also knew that, no matter how much money was raised at that time, not a single dollar could be used to help alleviate the #1 challenge young candidates face: financial hardship.

It's one thing to _know_ the system is rigged against young people and the working class. It is another to witness first hand the lengths a candidate like Maxwell, who is not independently wealthy, must go to just to pay the bills.

Earlier this year, Maxwell (aka “Congressman Frost”, first Gen Z Member of the House) testified in front of the FEC. His stories of driving Uber into the early hours of the morning just to make ends meet on the campaign trail were more than just tales of hardship– _they were a testament to an uneven playing field._

And I’m thrilled to share that the FEC just approved a new rule that would allow candidates to use campaign funds for a salary while they are running for office. **Now, even more young, working-class candidates can run for office and break into the system that’s built to keep them out.** [Maxwell and Leaders We Deserve are fighting to make our political system more accessible to young, working-class people. Tom is the proud husband to Rhonda and the proud father to two beautiful daughters. Their family resides in the wonderful city of Westfield, New Jersey. Tom's commitment to the people of New Jersey has been inspired by a legacy of **dedicated public service** from his grandfather, former U.S. Representative Robert Kean, to his father, former Governor Thomas H. Kean Sr. Kean has always understood and recognized the importance of civic engagement and is honored to **represent the people of New Jersey's 7th Congressional District** in Congress. From his early days in the Environmental Protection Agency during the George H.W. Bush Administration (where he met his incredible wife Rhonda), to serving as a volunteer firefighter and an emergency medical technician in Washington, D.C. — Tom has always had a heart for making our world a better, freer, safer place. Determined to answer the call to public service again, Tom Kean Jr. believed he, personally, could turn ideas into action and make a lasting difference in people’s lives. In 2001, Tom was elected to the New Jersey General Assembly, and two years later, was named to the upper house of the state legislature after his tireless work in ethics reform. Then in 2008, his peers unanimously elected him Republican Leader in the New Jersey Senate. Shortly thereafter, he unveiled his caucus’ job creation package, **“Common-Sense Plan for a More Affordable New Jersey,”** which ultimately reversed the course that previous administrations were quickly leading the state down. To this day, Tom continues to build upon his proven track record of delivering for the people of New Jersey in Congress:
* **Passed legislation advocating for Veteran-Owned small businesses**

* **Passed a resolution affirming strong US support for Ukraine**

body:
| Hello,

This is House Democratic Whip Katherine Clark. I want to take a moment to explain why this end-of-year fundraising push is so important, especially for my colleague, Sharice Davids.

At the end of each quarter, fundraising numbers are submitted by campaigns to the Federal Election Commission (or the FEC), which are then published for everyone to see.

**And when I say everyone, I mean _everyone._** Dark money GOP super PACs, extreme right wing groups, and national Republican megadonors are watching, especially now that we’ll be entering an election year.

Posting strong numbers, including the total number of grassroots donors who support this important work, will showcase the strength and momentum behind taking back the House and putting Democrats in charge.

On the flip side, showing _any_ signs of vulnerability could invite attacks from the right. **This is particularly true for Sharice — they’re one of the top targets of extreme MAGA Republicans who are raising record-breaking amounts of money to flip this seat and expand their majority in the House.**

The millions the GOP raises will directly translate to the size and scope of attack ads they’ll lob against Democrats, so grassroots support has a huge impact in our ability to fight back.

Hitting this goal means that Sharice and I will have the resources we need to respond to any attacks, build winning campaigns, and flip the House blue.

I want to take a moment to explain why this end-of-year fundraising push is so important, especially for my colleague, Sharice Davids. At the end of each quarter, fundraising numbers are submitted by campaigns to the Federal Election Commission (or the FEC), which are then published for everyone to see. Posting strong numbers, including the total number of grassroots donors who support this important work, will showcase the strength and momentum behind taking back the House and putting Democrats in charge. On the flip side, showing any signs of vulnerability could invite attacks from the right. I need your help to go "three up...three down" against this lineup of liberal career politicians. That's a bit of baseball vernacular. No surprise, right? It means you record three outs against the first three batters in an inning. Then, it's your team's turn to go on offense. Think about the daily reality of:
---
• Fear of walking down the street, taking their kids to school, or running a small business because of rampant crime, homelessness, and drug addiction. • The exploding cost of living (gas, food, shelter) which for the first time in our history is causing more people to leave California. • Failing public schools and plummeting test scores. The numbers don't lie... prolonged school closings not only robbed our kids of learning but of social interaction.
---

clean_body: | | | | | | Fellow American, That's the day of the California primary. The top two go head-to-head in November. I can think of only one thing worse than a General Election ballot that forces Californians to "choose" between three dyed-in-the-wool leftists like Schiff, Porter, or Lee... ...and that's being forced to endure six years of Schiff, Porter, or Lee in the U.S. Senate. I need your help to go "three up...three down" against this lineup of liberal career politicians. That's a bit of baseball vernacular. No surprise, right? It means you record three outs against the first three batters in an inning. Then, it's your team's turn to go on offense. Well, that's very much the case in this election... ...you and I need to strike out this lineup of liberals so we can get to work saving our country. Liberals straight out of Congress where all three have spent a combined 51 years - most recently acting as rubberstamps for the Biden agenda that has done so much harm to our state and our nation. Which is why I'm reaching out to you today. Think about the crumbling quality of life in my once-great state of California. Think about the daily reality of: • Fear of walking down the street, taking their kids to school, or running a small business because of rampant crime, homelessness, and drug addiction. • The exploding cost of living (gas, food, shelter) which for the first time in our history is causing more people to leave California. • Failing public schools and plummeting test scores. The numbers don't lie... prolonged school closings not only robbed our kids of learning but of social interaction. If you believe, as I do, that voters deserve better than a "false choice" between Schiff, Porter, and Lee on November 5, 2024, Winning this election requires a one-two punch: 1\. Finish in the top two on March 5th (very doable as the Democrat vote will be split three ways). 2\. An eight-month grassroots and TV, radio, and online campaign "connecting the dots" between the policies pushed by Schiff/Porter/Lee and the brutal reality facing Californians every day. In my playing days, I would never be out-worked or out-hustled. That's my approach to this campaign. Door-knocks, phone-calls, rallies, townhalls, you name it. With you on our side, I'm confident we can not only give voters a real choice, but someone who remembers how great California was and knows how great it can be again. | | With deepest appreciation, Steve Garvey Republican for United States Senate | | | | | | | MY VISION My campaign is focused on quality-of-life issues, public safety, and education. As your U.S. Senator, I will serve with commonsense, compassion, and will work to build consensus to benefit all of the people of California. I've been fortunate to wear many hats in life - from professional athlete to businessman to philanthropist. But the one thing that has remained consistent is my love for this great state and my desire to make a difference. In baseball, it's not about the individual; it's about the team. I believe the same holds true for politics. It's time we come together, find common ground, and work towards a brighter future. | | | | PAID FOR BY STEVE GARVEY FOR U.S. SENATE 9070 Irvine Center Drive, Suite 150 Irvine, CA 92618 | | This Email was Sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com If you would like to stop recieving our emails ****_ |

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76139552/446742017/983305604?refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2023.12.30_B2_EOY4_Actives_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDQ1ODUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZWFlMDM0ZjMtNjlhNy1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIxZjU0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=mTqvVmBg6r1zZgbOeAbGjmy709fB6v81sACO8n6vcmY=) Peter, that's me and my late great-great-grandfather, Robert Smalls. Robert's life epitomized what it meant to get into good trouble, and his example inspires me every day. I'm going to tell you more about his story and after, I hope you'll feel inspired to [_**chip in a few bucks to help me reach my end-of-year goal and win my battleground race here in South Carolina.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76139553/446742018/983305604?refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2023.12.30_B2_EOY4_Actives_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDQ1ODUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZWFlMDM0ZjMtNjlhNy1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIxZjU0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=mTqvVmBg6r1zZgbOeAbGjmy709fB6v81sACO8n6vcmY=) Robert was born a slave and was conscripted into the Confederacy to be a ship pilot during the Civil War. Because of his skills, he acquired the trust of the Confederate captains aboard his ship, the _Planter._ On an evening when the Confederate captains left the ship, Robert used his self-taught skills as a pilot to steer himself, and his Black crewmates and their families to safety in the North. The families that Robert steered to safety were given safe harbor, and the ship was gifted to the Union – helping build their naval fleet and win the war. Robert later came back to South Carolina and served as Congressman for Beaufort, dedicated to fighting injustice everywhere. My great-great-grandfather had the audacity to risk everything he had, never tire, and lead a life of service. **I'm running against Nancy Mace in my battleground district of SC-01 because Robert Smalls' fight isn't over, and I know South Carolina's best days are still ahead of us.** December is one of the most important months of our campaign. With a big end-of-year fundraising goal hurdling our way, we must generate as much grassroots momentum as possible. [_**I'm running for Congress to fight for families across the Lowcountry and continue the legacy of service instilled in me by my great-great-grandfather. clean_body: | = Peter, that's me and my late great-great-grandfather, Robert Smalls. Robert's life epitomized what it meant to get into good trouble, and his example inspires me every day. I'm going to tell you more about his story and after, I hope you'll feel inspired to = Robert was born a slave and was conscripted into the Confederacy to be a ship pilot during the Civil War. Because of his skills, he acquired the trust of the Confederate captains aboard his ship, the Planter. On an evening when the Confederate captains left the ship, Robert used his self-taught skills as a pilot to steer himself, and his Black crewmates and their families to safety in the North. The families that Robert steered to safety were given safe harbor, and the ship was gifted to the Union – helping build their naval fleet and win the war. Robert later came back to South Carolina and served as Congressman for Beaufort, dedicated to fighting injustice everywhere. My great-great-grandfather had the audacity to risk everything he had, never tire, and lead a life of service. I'm running against Nancy Mace in my battleground district of SC-01 because Robert Smalls' fight isn't over, and I know South Carolina's best days are still ahead of us. December is one of the most important months of our campaign.
